sun.kids: Owia yɛ gas a ɛhyerɛn bɔɔl kɛseɛ pa ara, na ɛso araa ma Asase bɛyɛ ɔpepem baako bɛtumi ahyɛ ne mu! Ne hann a ɛyɛ hyew no tu fa ahunmu ntɛm so, na ɛgye sima nwɔtwe ansa na aduru yɛn nkyɛn.
sun.middle: Owia ne nsoromma a ɛbɛn yɛn paa; ɛyɛ hydrogen ne helium gas bɔɔl kɛseɛ a ɛhyerɛn, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ bɛyɛ 1,391,000 km — ɛbɛyɛ Asase tɛtrɛtɛ mpɛn 109. Ɛkura owia-kuo (solar system) no mu adeɛ nyinaa mu duru bɛyɛ 99.86%, na ne tweɛ ahoɔden (gravity) ma okyinnsoromma biara kɔ so kyini twa ne ho. Ne mfinimfini tɔnn no, hydrogen ka bom dane helium wɔ ɔhyew a ɛbɛyɛ 15 million °C mu, na ɛgyaa hann ne ɔhyew a ɛma nkwa tumi tena Asase so. Saa hann no gye bɛyɛ sima 8 ne sekan 20 ansa na aduru yɛn nkyɛn. Owia adi bɛyɛ mfeɛ ɔpepepem 4.6, na ɔwɔ ne nkwa a ɔde bɛtena hɔ sɛ nsoromma a ɛgyina pintinn na ɛhye hydrogen no mfimfini pɛɛ.
sun.high:
Owia ne nsoromma a ɛwɔ yɛn owia-kuo (solar system) no mfimfini, na ɛne adeɛ kɛseɛ pa ara a ɛwɔ mu; ɛkura owia-kuo no nyinaa mu duru bɛyɛ ɔha mu 99.8 (99.8 percent). Ne tɛtrɛtɛ (diameter) yɛ bɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 1.39, a ɛso ara ma wobɛtumi de Asase bɛyɛ 109 atoatoa so afa n'anim, na Asase bɛboro ɔpepem baako bɛtumi ahyɛ ne mu. Owia yɛ plasma a ɛyɛ hyew bɔɔl kɛseɛ a hydrogen (bɛyɛ ɔha mu 74) ne helium (bɛyɛ ɔha mu 24) na ɛdɔɔso wɔ mu. Ne mfinimfini tɔnn no, ɔhyew duru bɛyɛ 15 million degrees Celsius, baabi a hydrogen ka bom dane helium na ɛgyaa ahoɔden a ɛhyerɛn na ɛma yɛn wiase yɛ hyew. N'ani a yɛhunu no, a wɔfrɛ no photosphere no, dwo kyɛn saa koraa; ɛyɛ bɛyɛ 5,500 degrees Celsius.

Owia wɔ baabi a ɛne Asase ntam kwan yɛ bɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 150, kwan a wɔfrɛ no astronomical unit baako, na ne hann gye bɛyɛ sima nwɔtwe ansa na aduru yɛn nkyɛn. Ɛnkyini ntwa okyinnsoromma biara ho; mmom ɛkyini twa Milky Way galaxy no mfimfini ho, na ɛgye bɛyɛ mfeɛ ɔpepem 225 kɔsi 250 ansa na awie akyinkyini baako. Esiane sɛ Owia yɛ plasma nti, ɛkyinkyini wɔ ahoɔhare ahodoɔ mu: bɛyɛ nna 25 wɔ ne equator (ne mfimfini kwan) so, na ɛboro nna 30 wɔ n'atifi ne n'ase (poles) no ho. Photosphere no atifi na ne wim (atmosphere) no wɔ, a chromosphere a ɛyɛ kɔkɔɔ kakra ne corona a ɛnyɛ hyerɛn pii nanso ɛyɛ hyew boro so ka ho; corona no ɔhyew bɛtumi aduru ɔpepem degrees pii, na yɛhunu no bere a owia-yɛ-sum (total solar eclipse) si. Owia nni ani a ɛyɛ den, na ɛnni ɔsram biara, nanso nkyinnsoromma no nyinaa kyini twa ne ho.

Nnipa adi Owia ni mfeɛ mpempem pii. Tete Egyptfoɔ som owia nyame Ra, na Greecefoɔ ka Helios a ɔka ne teaseɛnam fa wim ho asɛm. Ɛnnɛ, ahunmu hyɛn sua ne ho adeɛ fɛfɛɛfɛ: NASA Parker Solar Probe a wɔtoo no 2018 no atu abɛn Owia sene ahunmu hyɛn biara wɔ abakɔsɛm mu, na adwuma te sɛ SOHO ne Solar Orbiter hwɛ n'ahum. Owia ho nteaseɛ boa yɛn ma yɛtumi ka ahunmu wim tebea (space weather) a ɛbɛtumi aka satellite ne Asase so anyinam ahoɔden nhoma (power grids) no ho asɛm.
sun.adult:
Owia yɛ G-type main-sequence nsoromma (spectral class G2V), nsoromma kɔkɔɔ ketewa (yellow dwarf) a ɛnyɛ nwanwa biara sɛ wode toto galaxy no mu deɛ ho a, nanso ɛho hia Asase so nkwa kɛseɛ pa ara. Ɛbaeɛ bɛyɛ mfeɛ ɔpepepem 4.6 a atwam ni, ɛfiri gas ne mfuturo mununkum a ɛkyinkyini a wɔfrɛ no solar nebula a tweɛ ahoɔden (gravity) maa ɛtɔɔ guu mu. Bere a mununkum no reka ne ho abom no, ne mu nneɛma dodoɔ no ara tɔɔ guu mfimfini, baabi a nhyɛsoɔ ne ɔhyew a ɛrekɔ soro no hyɛɛ nuclear fusion ase akyire yi; disk a ɛkaa hɔ no na ɛwoo nkyinnsoromma, nsram, asteroids ne comets. Saa adeɛ baako yi kura owia-kuo (solar system) no nyinaa mu duru bɛyɛ ɔha mu 99.8, tumi kɛseɛ a ɛdi biribiara a atwa ne ho ahyia no akyinkyini so.

Sɛ yɛhwɛ ne kɛseyɛ ankasa a, Owia yɛ nwanwa. Ne tɛtrɛtɛ (diameter) yɛ bɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 1.39, bɛyɛ Asase deɛ mpɛn 109, na ne mu kwan (volume) bɛtumi akora Asase boro ɔpepem 1.3. Ne mu duru (mass) yɛ bɛyɛ 1.989 x 10^30 kilograms, bɛyɛ Asase mu duru mpɛn 333,000. Yei nyinaa akyi no, ne density a ɛtaa yɛ no yɛ bɛyɛ gram 1.4 wɔ cubic centimeter biara mu pɛ, Asase deɛ nkyɛmu nnan mu baako, ɛfiri sɛ Owia nyɛ adeɛ a ɛyɛ den, na mmom ɛyɛ plasma bɔɔl kɛseɛ. Sɛ yɛhwɛ ne mu duru a, ne mu nneɛma yɛ bɛyɛ hydrogen ɔha mu 74 ne helium ɔha mu 24, na oxygen, carbon, neon, iron ne nneɛma foforɔ a emu yɛ duru a nsoromma a ɛdii kan baeɛ yɛeɛ no ka ho kakraa bi.

Owia ɔhyew sesa kɛseɛ sɛ wokɔ ne mu tɔnn. Ne mfinimfini no ɔhyew duru bɛyɛ 15 million degrees Celsius, ɛyɛ hyew na emu yɛ duru sɛdeɛ ɛbɛtumi aka hydrogen nuclei abom ama adane helium ɛnam proton-proton chain so, na ɛdane adeɛ (matter) bɛyɛ tɔn ɔpepem 4 yɛ ahoɔden sekan biara. Saa ahoɔden no gye mfeɛ mpem du du pii ansa na atu afa radiative zone ne convective zone no mu akɔ abɔnten ansa na afiri ani a yɛhunu no, photosphere, a ɛhyerɛn wɔ bɛyɛ 5,500 degrees Celsius no. Saa fusion a ɛkɔ so daa yi ama Owia ahyerɛn pintinn mfeɛ ɔpepepem pii, na nsoromma ho nimdefoɔ (astronomers) abu akyerɛ sɛ ɛwɔ hydrogen a ɛbɛsɔ ama ɛakɔ so ayɛ main-sequence nsoromma a ɛgyina pintinn bɛyɛ mfeɛ ɔpepepem 5 bio.

---

Ɛwom sɛ yɛka sɛ nkyinnsoromma kyini twa Owia ho deɛ, nanso Owia no ankasa nso nam daa. Ɛtu fa Milky Way galaxy no mfimfini ho wɔ ahoɔhare a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 220 sekan biara, na ɛwie galaxy akyinkyini baako, a wɔfrɛ no cosmic year (ahunmu afe) no, wɔ bɛyɛ mfeɛ ɔpepem 225 kɔsi 250 mu. Owia nni ɔsram biara na ɛnni nkaa (rings) biara a ɛyɛ ne dea; mmom ɛnam ne tweɛ ahoɔden kɛseɛ so kura nkyinnsoromma nwɔtwe, nkyinnsoromma nketewa (dwarf planets) ne nneɛma nketenkete a wɔntumi nkan abusua. Asase kyini twa ne ho wɔ kwan a ɛtaa yɛ bɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 150, a wɔahyɛ no sɛ astronomical unit baako, na owia hann twa saa kwan no wɔ bɛyɛ sima nwɔtwe ne sekan aduonu mu.

Esiane sɛ Owia yɛ plasma bɔɔl a ɛsen (fluid) na ɛnyɛ adeɛ a ɛyɛ den nti, ɛkyinkyini wɔ ahoɔhare ahodoɔ mu (differential rotation): ne equator wie kyinkyini baako wɔ bɛyɛ nna 25 mu, na mmeaeɛ a ɛbɛn n'atifi ne n'ase (poles) gye bɛyɛ nna 35. Saa kyinkyini ahodoɔ yi kyinkyim na ɛtoatoa Owia magnetic field no, na ɛde dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ (cycle) a ɛyɛ mfeɛ 11 a sunspots, owia-gyaframa (solar flares) ne coronal mass ejections yɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ba. Sunspots yɛ mmeaeɛ a ɛdwo na ɛyɛ tuntum a magnetic fields a emu yɛ den siw convection kwan wɔ hɔ, na ne dodoɔ kɔ soro ba fam sɛdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no teɛ.

Owia mu no yɛ ntoatoasoɔ: mfinimfini a fusion ma no tumi, radiative zone a ahoɔden tu fa mu kɔ abɔnten sɛ hann, ne abɔnten convective zone a plasma a ɛyɛ hyew foro kɔ soro na ɛsane ba fam te sɛ nsuo a ɛrehuru, na ɛma n'ani so yɛ granular (nkuruwankuruwa) sɛdeɛ yɛhunu no. Photosphere no atifi na wim (atmosphere) no wɔ, chromosphere a ɛyɛ tenaa na ɛyɛ kɔkɔɔ kakra, ne corona a ɛyɛ hahaa a, nea ɛyɛ nwanwa ne sɛ, ne ɔhyew foro boro degrees Celsius ɔpepem baako, ɛyɛ hyew sene ani a ɛwɔ n'ase no koraa, ahintasɛm a abɔdeɛ ho nimdefoɔ da so sua. Corona no sen kɔ abɔnten daa sɛ owia mframa (solar wind), nneɛma nketenkete a ɛwɔ anyinam tumi (charged particles) a ɛsen a ɛhyɛ owia-kuo no ma na ɛhyehyɛ nkyinnsoromma magnetospheres. Sɛ saa mframa yi bɔ Asase magnetic field a, ɛma auroras a ɛhyerɛn kyerɛkyerɛ no ba, na ɛbɛtumi ama geomagnetic ahum nso aba.

---

Adesamma ne Owia ntam abusuabɔ akyɛ te sɛ amammerɛ no ankasa. Aman ne mmusuakuo nyinaa ara de no sii wɔn anansesɛm ne wɔn nyamesom mfimfini: tete Egyptfoɔ dii Ra ni, deɛ ɔde hyɛn twa wim awia na ɔfa asamando anadwo; Greecefoɔ yɛɛ no sɛ onipa, Helios, a ɔka teaseɛnam a ɛredɛre; na amammerɛ ahodoɔ, ɛfiri Aztecfoɔ kɔsi Japanfoɔ a wɔn frankaa da so ara kura owia a ɛrepue no, yɛɛ kalenda, nkaeɛ adan ne afahyɛ gyinaa ne nsakraeɛ so. Stonehenge ne tete mmeaeɛ bebree a wɔntumi nkan toa solstices (owia nsakraeɛ bere) so, na ɛdi adanseɛ sɛ tete nnipa hwɛɛ Owia afe akwantuo no ahwɛyie.

Nyansa nimdeɛ ho nteaseɛ nyinii nkakrankakra. Galileo de telescope hwɛɛ sunspots wɔ mfeɛ 1600 no ahyɛaseɛ, na ɛgyee ɔsoro a ɛyɛ pɛ na ɛnsakra adwene no akyinnyeɛ, na mfeɛ ɔha a ɛdii ɛno anim no, Copernicus heliocentric nhwɛsoɔ no, a ɛde Owia na ɛnyɛ Asase sii mfimfini no, sesaa sɛdeɛ adesamma hunu wɔn gyinabea wɔ wiase kɛseɛ no mu. Ɛnnɛ, ahunmu hyɛn akuo bi sua Owia ho adeɛ. NASA ne ESA SOHO ahwɛ no firi 1995; Solar Dynamics Observatory twa ne mfoni daa; ESA Solar Orbiter twa n'atifi ne n'ase (poles) mfoni; na NASA Parker Solar Probe, a wɔtoo no 2018 no, atu afa corona no ankasa mu, abɛn Owia sene ahunmu hyɛn biara wɔ abakɔsɛm mu, na agyina ɔhyew a ano yɛ den ano wɔ kyɛm a ɛbɔ ho ban akyi.

Saa nhwehwɛmu yi ho hia boro anibereɛ so. Owia ne ahoɔden a ɛwɔ Asase so nyinaa ara fibea titire, ɛma photosynthesis, wim tebea, ɛpo nsuo asutene ne aduane nhyehyɛeɛ (food chains) a ɛma nkwa tena hɔ no tumi. Ne hann ne ne ɔhyew ma yɛn okyinnsoromma yi yɛ beaeɛ a wɔbɛtumi atena so, na ne ahoɔden a ɛmaeɛ pintinn mfeɛ ɔpepepem pii no maa nkwa nyaa bere a ɛhia no de nyinii. Saa bere korɔ no ara mu, n'ahum, owia-gyaframa ne coronal mass ejections, bɛtumi asɛe satellites, radio nkitahodie, akwankyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ (navigation systems) ne anyinam ahoɔden nhoma (power grids), na ɛma ahunmu wim tebea (space weather) nkɔmhyɛ yɛ adeɛ a ɛho hia ankasa ma ɛnnɛ mfiridwuma wiase. Sɛ nsoromma a ɛyɛ nsoromma kwa wɔ nsoromma ɔpepepem ɔha pii a ɛwɔ Milky Way no mu no, Owia nso ne yɛn nhwehwɛmu dan a ɛbɛn yɛn paa a yɛde bɛte nsoromma a ɛwɔ baabiara ase.

mercury.kids: Mercury ne okyinnsoromma (planet) a ɛsua koraa wɔ okyinnsoromma nyinaa mu, na ɔno na ɔbɛn Owia sen biara. Ɔtu mmirika twa Owia ho nyinaa wɔ nnafua 88 pɛ mu! N'afã baako hyew araa kosi sɛ ebetumi anan sumpii (lead), na afã baako no nso wɔ sum mu a awɔw akyekyere no!
mercury.middle: Mercury ne okyinnsoromma a ɛsua koraa; ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ bɛyɛ 4,879 km pɛ — ɛboro Asase tɛtrɛtɛ no nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu baako kakra. Ɔno na ɔbɛn Owia sen okyinnsoromma biara (bɛyɛ 58 million km), na ɔtu mmirika twa Owia ho wɔ Asase nnafua 88 pɛ mu — ɔno ne okyinnsoromma a ne ho yɛ hare sen biara. Nanso ɔkyinkyim ne ho brɛoo paa, enti Mercury so awia-ne-anadwo baako kyɛ bɛyɛ Asase nnafua 176. Esiane sɛ ɔnni mframa (atmosphere) a ɛbɛkora ɔhyew so nti, ɔhyew ne awɔw sesa kɛse: ɛkɔ soro kosi bɛyɛ 430 °C wɔ owia hann mu, na ɛkɔ fam kosi bɛyɛ −180 °C anadwo. Ne ho a ɛyɛ nsonso a amena akɛse (craters) wɔ so no te sɛ yɛn Ɔsram, na mpo nsukyenee (ice) bi hintaw wɔ amena a emu dɔ wɔ n'atifi ne n'anafo (poles) a owia hann nnu hɔ da.
mercury.high:
Mercury ne okyinnsoromma a ɛsua koraa wɔ yɛn owia-nhyehyɛe (solar system) mu, na ɔno nso na ɔbɛn Owia sen biara. Ne tɛtrɛtɛ (diameter) yɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 4,879, enti ɔso sen Asase Ɔsram kakraa bi pɛ. Ɛwom sɛ ɔsua de, nanso Mercury mu yɛ duru paa sɛ wode toto ne kɛse ho a: ɔno ne okyinnsoromma a ne mu yɛ duru sen biara (density) a ɔto so abien wɔ Asase akyi. Saa duru yi fi ne dade-mfimfini (iron core) kɛse no, a ɛhyɛ okyinnsoromma no radius no bɛyɛ ɔha mu 85 ma, na ɔbo-ntama (rocky mantle) ne ne nhwi (crust) a ɛyɛ tratraa akata so. Mercury so nsrɛdeɛ ahoɔden (surface gravity) yɛ bɛyɛ mita 3.7 wɔ sekan anan biara (3.7 m/s²), a ɛyɛ Asase de no bɛyɛ ɔha mu 38 pɛ, enti sɛ onipa gyina hɔ a, ɔbɛte nka sɛ ne mu yɛ hare koraa.

Mercury twa Owia ho wɔ akyirikyiri a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 58 (58 million) mu, na otwa ho pɛnkoro wɔ Asase nnafua 88 pɛ mu — ɔno ne okyinnsoromma a ɔtwa Owia ho ntɛm sen biara. Nanso ne nkyinkyim (rotation) yɛ brɛoo: okyinnsoromma no kyinkyim ne ho pɛnkoro Asase nnafua 59 biara. Mercury hyɛ nhyehyɛe a wɔfrɛ no 3:2 resonance mu, a ɔkyinkyim ne ho mprɛnsa pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ bere a ɔtwa Owia ho mprenu biara. Eyi nti, owia da baako, efi owia pue baako so kosi owia pue a edi so no, kyɛ bɛyɛ Asase nnafua 176, a ɛyɛ n'afe no mprenu. Ne kwan (orbit) no nso na atwetwe sen biara (eccentric), na ɛde no bɛn Owia kosi kilomita ɔpepem 46 (46 million) na ɛde no kɔ akyiri kosi kilomita ɔpepem 70 (70 million).

Mercury nni ɔsram biara na onni nkaa (rings) nso. Onni mframa (atmosphere) nso kɛse — exosphere a ɛyɛ tratraa koraa nko ara na ɛwɔ hɔ, a ɛyɛ atoms a wɔabɔ afi ne ho so, a oxygen, sodium, hydrogen ne nneɛma afoforo wom. Esiane sɛ mframa kakraa bi pɛ na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛbɛkora ɔhyew so nti, ɔhyew ne awɔw sesa kɛse: awia ɔhyew no kɔ soro kosi bɛyɛ 430 degrees Celsius, na anadwo ɛkɔ fam kosi bɛyɛ -180 degrees Celsius. Ne ho a amena (craters) ahyɛ so ma, a Caloris Basin kɛse no ayɛ no twa no, te sɛ Ɔsram, nanso nsukyenee (ice) hintaw wɔ amena a ɛwɔ sum mu wɔ n'atifi ne n'anafo (poles) a owia hann nnu hɔ da. Romafo too okyinnsoromma no din Mercury de too wɔn nyame a ɔyɛ ɔsomafo a ne ho yɛ hare no so, efisɛ ɔtwa mu wɔ wim ntɛmntɛm. Ahunmu-hyɛn (spacecraft) abiɛsa pɛ na akɔsra no: Mariner 10, NASA MESSENGER orbiter no, ne Europafo ne Japanfo BepiColombo mission a ɛredu hɔ seesei akosua wiase ketewa a ahyew yi.
mercury.adult:
Mercury ne okyinnsoromma awotwe no mu nea ɔwɔ mfimfini pɛɛ na ɔsua sen biara — wiase a ɛyɛ ɔbo a ahyew, a ɔtwa Owia ho bɛn no sen ne nuanom biara. Ne tɛtrɛtɛ wɔ ne equator no yɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 4,879, enti ne tɛtrɛtɛ boro Asase Ɔsram de no bɛyɛ ɔha mu 40 pɛ, na ɔsua sen asram Ganymede ne Titan. Nanso Mercury de nneɛma (matter) pii ahyɛ saa nipadua ketewa yi mu. Ne density a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ gram 5.43 wɔ sentimita kubik biara mu (5.43 g/cm³) nti, ɔno ne okyinnsoromma a ne mu yɛ duru sen biara a ɔto so abien wɔ owia-nhyehyɛe no mu, Asase nko ara na odi n'anim — na Asase nkontaabu a ɛkɔ soro no fã bi yɛ nnaadaa a nsrɛdeɛ-mia (gravitational compression) na ɛde ba. Sɛ wuyi saa mia no fi mu a, Mercury nneɛma a wɔmmiaa no no na ɛyɛ duru sen okyinnsoromma biara de ankasa.

Nea ɛde ba no wɔ n'ase tɔnn. Mercury wɔ dade-mfimfini (metallic core) a ɛso boro so, a dade (iron) na ɛdɔɔso wom, a ɛhyɛ okyinnsoromma no radius no bɛyɛ ɔha mu 85 ma na ɛyɛ ne mu duru (mass) no fã kɛse. Nea atwa saa mfimfini yi ho ahyia ne silicate mantle ne nhwi (crust) a ɛyɛ tratraa, a ne nyinaa bom mu piw yɛ kilomita ɔhaha kakraa bi pɛ. Okyinnsoromma ho nyansapɛfo de nkyerɛkyerɛmu ahorow pii aba sɛ nea enti a dade adɔɔso wom saa. Adwene baako kyerɛ sɛ ɔbo kɛse bi a ɛbɔɔ no wɔ owia-nhyehyɛe no abakɔsɛm mfiase no worɔw Mercury ɔbo-nhwi a na ɛwɔ akyi no mu pii fii hɔ, na ɛmaa mfimfini a ɛyɛ duru no daa adi boro so. Afoforo nso kyerɛ sɛ ɔhyew a ano yɛ den ne owia nhyerɛnne a na ɛwɔ ɛmfimfini-nhyehyɛe a na ɛyɛ foforo no mu no maa nneɛma a ɛyɛ hare no yeraa anaa ɛamma wɔamboaboa ano.

Mercury mu duru nyinaa yɛ bɛyɛ 3.3 a wɔde du a wɔama so kosi 23 abɔ mu (3.3 × 10^23) kilogram, a ɛyɛ Asase de no bɛyɛ ɔha mu 5.5, na ne so nsrɛdeɛ ahoɔden yɛ bɛyɛ mita 3.7 wɔ sekan anan biara (3.7 m/s²), a ɛyɛ nea yɛte nka wɔ Asase so no bɛyɛ ɔha mu 38. Ne ho ankasa yɛ dedaw, nsonso, na amena ahyɛ so ma — ɛyɛ mfe ɔpepepem pii a nneɛma abobɔ no no ho kyerɛwtohɔ. Abotan atifi atenten a ɛkyea a wɔfrɛ no lobate scarps twa asase no mu, a ɛyɛ nkyekyemu a ɛbae bere a okyinnsoromma no nyinaa tɔɔ sin bere a ne mu redwo brɛoo na ɛrekyekyɛ no. Wɔ akwan pii so no, Mercury yɛ owia-nhyehyɛe a edi kan no asinasin a wɔakora so, na n'anim a abobɔ no yɛ mfɛnsere a ɛma yehu akwan a ɛmaa okyinnsoromma a ɛyɛ ɔbo nyinaa yɛɛ nea ɛte nnɛ.

---

Mercury nkyinkyim a ɔde twa Owia ho no yɛ nneɛma a ɛboro so ho nhwɛso. Ɔtu mmirika wɔ ne kwan so wɔ ahoɔhare a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 47 wɔ sekan biara mu, na owie ne nkyinkyim mũ wɔ Asase nnafua 88 pɛ mu — afe a ɛyɛ tiaa sen okyinnsoromma biara de. Ne kwan nso na atwetwe sen biara (eccentric), ɛyɛ ellipse a ɛtenten a ɛde no bɛn Owia kosi bɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 46 wɔ perihelion na ɛde no kɔ akyiri kosi bɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 70 wɔ aphelion, a ne nkyɛmu bɛn kilomita ɔpepem 58. Saa kwan a atwetwe yi yɛɛ nsoromma-ho-nyansapɛfo nwonwa bere bi: Mercury kwan no nkyinkyim brɛoo (precession) no, Newton nsrɛdeɛ ho mmara no antumi ankyerɛkyerɛ mu nyinaa, na ne mmuae bɛyɛɛ Einstein ne general theory of relativity no nkonimdi a edi kan a agye din.

Okyinnsoromma no nkyinkyim ne ho nso yɛ soronko saa ara. Mercury kyinkyim ne ho wɔ n'axis so pɛnkoro Asase nnafua 58.6 biara, a ɛhyɛ 3:2 spin-orbit resonance mu, a ɔkyinkyim ne ho mprɛnsa pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ nkyinkyim mprenu biara a ɔde twa Owia ho mu. Eyi nti, owia da baako, a wosusuw fi owia pue baako so kosi nea edi so no, trɛw kɔ bɛyɛ Asase nnafua 176, anaa Mercury mfe mũ abien. Obi a ɔwɔ ne ho so bɛhwɛ Owia sɛ ɛretwa akwan a ɛyɛ nwonwa wɔ wim bere a ɛbɛn perihelion, a ɛbɛyɛ sɛ egyina na ɛsan n'akyi kakra ansa na ɛatoa so.

Mercury nni ɔsram biara na onni nkaa nhyehyɛe (ring system) nso. Ne mframa (atmosphere) nni mu — ɛyɛ exosphere a ɛyɛ tratraa a emu atoms no ntaa nhyia wɔn ho, a oxygen, sodium, hydrogen, helium ne potassium na ɛwom, a owia mframa (solar wind) ne nneɛma nketenkete a ɛbɔ no (micrometeorite impacts) san hyɛ no ma bere nyinaa, na saa ara nso na ɛworɔw no fi hɔ. Esiane sɛ mframa biara nni hɔ a ɛbɛkata so nti, ne ho ɔhyew fi bɛyɛ 430 degrees Celsius wɔ owia hann mu tɔnn kosi bɛyɛ -180 degrees Celsius wɔ anadwo tenten no mu. Nea ɛyɛ nwonwa ne sɛ, nsu-nsukyenee (water ice) tena amena a sum wom daa a ɛbɛn n'atifi ne n'anafo (poles) mu, a wɔabɔ ho ban afi Owia ho afebɔɔ. Wɔ n'ase tɔnn no, dade-mfimfini a ɛfã bi anan (partially molten iron core) ma magnetic field a ɛka wiase no nyinaa a emu nyɛ den nanso ɛwɔ hɔ ampa ba, a n'ahoɔden yɛ Asase de no bɛyɛ ɔha mu baako — ade a ɛyɛ nwonwa ma nipadua a ɛsua saa, na ɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Mercury mu da so reyɛ adwuma.

---

Adesamma anim Mercury fi tete bere mu, na ɔyɛ okyinnsoromma anum a yɛde ani hunu no mu baako. Esiane sɛ ɔmfi Owia ho nkɔ akyiri wɔ yɛn wim nti, bere tiaa bi pɛ na ɔda adi anɔpahema anaa anwummere, na tete aman pii susuwii sɛ anɔpa ne anwummere puei no yɛ nneɛma abien a ɛsono wɔn. Akyiri yi Helafo hui sɛ ɛyɛ ade baako, na wɔde hann-ketewa a ɛtu mmirika no too Hermes, anyame no somafo a ne nan yɛ hare no so; Romafo nso faa adwene koro no ara, na wɔtoo okyinnsoromma no din Mercury, wɔn somafo a ɔwɔ ntaban a ɔhwɛ aguadi ne akwantu so no din. Babilonfo nsoromma-ho-nyansapɛfo dii ne nkyinkyim akyi ansa na eyi reba koraa, na aman efi China kosi Maya kyerɛw n'akwantu a ɛnnyae no ho nsɛm.

Mercury ho nhwehwɛmu ayɛ den boro so, efisɛ sɛ wobɛdu wiase a ɛwɔ Owia nsrɛdeɛ amena no mu tɔnn saa a, ɛsɛ sɛ wotow nkyinkyim-ahoɔden (orbital energy) pii gu. Ahunmu-hyɛn abiɛsa pɛ na atu saa kwan no. NASA Mariner 10 twaa mu mprɛnsa wɔ 1974 ne 1975 mu, na ɛyɛɛ ne ho so a ɛnnu fã no mfonini. Mfe du pii akyi no, NASA MESSENGER bɛyɛɛ ahunmu-hyɛn a edi kan a ɛtwaa Mercury ho hyiae, a ɛtwaa ho fi 2011 kosi 2015, na ɛdaa n'asase nyinaa nhyehyɛe adi, ɛsii nsukyenee a ɛwɔ ne poles so no so dua, na ɛyɛɛ ne magnetic field ne ne mu nneɛma ho mfonini fitaa. Europafo ne Japanfo BepiColombo mission a wɔbom yɛe a wɔtoo no wɔ 2018 mu no rewie n'akwantu tenten a ɛkyinkyim no seesei na akɔhyɛ ne kwan (orbit) mu de ahunmu-hyɛn abien asua okyinnsoromma no bere koro mu.

Mercury ho hia boro ne kɛse a ɛsua no so koraa. Sɛ okyinnsoromma a ɔwɔ mfimfini pɛɛ no, Owia nkɛntɛnso ka no denneennen sen biara, enti ɔyɛ abɔde mu nhwehwɛmu-dan a ɛboa ma yɛte nea nsoromma yɛ wiase a atwa wɔn ho ahyia no ase. Ne mfimfini kɛse no ma yɛn nsusuwii a ɛfa sɛnea okyinnsoromma a ɛyɛ ɔbo yɛ ba no ho hyia nsɛmmisa, na ne nneyɛe boaa ma wosii physics mu adwene a emu dɔ sen biara no mu baako so dua. Ma mmusua a wɔhwɛ hann-ketewa a ɛtwa mu ntɛm a ɛwɔ fam wɔ wim-ano no, Mercury nso yɛ nkaebɔ sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛhyerɛn sen biara no taa fi mmeae a ɛsua, a ɛyɛ den sɛ wubehu — ɔsomafo a ne ho yɛ hare a ahyew, a ɔde owia-nhyehyɛe no ahemadakye ahintasɛm nam.

venus.kids: Venus ne okyinnsoromma a ɛyɛ hyew sen biara, na omununkum akokɔsradeɛ a ɛyɛ den akata ne ho a ɛkora ɔhyew te sɛ kuntu. Ɛdane ne ho kɔ akyi, enti wɔ Venus so no, Owia pue wɔ atɔeɛ na ɛtɔ wɔ apueeɛ!
venus.middle: Venus ne okyinnsoromma a ɛtɔ so mmienu firi Owia so, na ne kɛseɛ te sɛ Asase deɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ te sɛ ne nua ta — ɛbɛyɛ 12,104 km wɔ ne ntrɛmu. Nanso ɛno ne okyinnsoromma a ɛyɛ hyew sen biara wɔ owia nhyehyɛeɛ no mu, ɛbɛyɛ 465 °C, ɔhyew a ɛbɛtumi anane sumpii (lead). Mframa a ɛyɛ den a ɛyɛ carbon dioxide ne omununkum a ɛyɛ sulfuric acid kora ɔhyew wɔ runaway greenhouse nsunsuansoɔ mu, na nhyɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ ne so no boro Asase deɛ so bɛyɛ mpɛn 90. Venus dane ne ho kɔ akyi (retrograde) na ɛdane brɛoo ara ma da baako kyɛ sene n'afe: Asase nna 243 ansa na ɛdane ne ho pɛnkoro, nanso Asase nna 225 pɛ na ɛde twa Owia ho hyia. Sɛ yɛhwɛ firi Asase so a, ɛhyerɛn sɛ 'anɔpa nsoromma' anaa 'anwummerɛ nsoromma' a ɛyɛ hyerɛn, abɔdeɛ a ɛhyerɛn sen biara wɔ yɛn ewiem wɔ Owia ne Ɔsrane akyi.
venus.high:
Venus ne okyinnsoromma a ɛtɔ so mmienu firi Owia so, na ɛno ne okyinnsoromma a ɛbɛn Asase sen biara. Wɔtaa frɛ no Asase ne nua ta ɛfiri sɛ wiase mmienu yi kɛseɛ sɛ koraa. Venus ntrɛmu (diameter) bɛyɛ kilomita 12,104, a ɛbɛyɛ Asase ntrɛmu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 95, na ne mu duru bɛyɛ Asase deɛ mpɛn 0.815. Ne so asase twetwe (gravity) yɛ mita 8.87 wɔ sekan a wɔabɔ ho mpɛn mmienu (meters per second squared), enti nsrahwɛfoɔ bi bɛte nka sɛ wayɛ hare kakra bi sene sɛdeɛ ɔte wɔ fie. Omununkum a ɛyɛ den no ase no, Venus yɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛyɛ ɔbotan a ɛwɔ dadeɛ mfimfini (core), ɔbotan mantle, ne akyi ahoma (crust), te sɛ akyinnsoromma a ɛwɔ emu afoforɔ no ara pɛ. Nanso ɛwom sɛ nsɛm yi sesɛ deɛ, Venus bɛyɛɛ fononoo a ɛyɛ hu sene sɛ ɛbɛyɛ Asase a ɛtɔ so mmienu.

Venus twa Owia ho hyia wɔ akyirikyiri a ɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 108, anaa astronomical units 0.72, na ɛde Asase nna 225 biara twa Owia ho pɛnkoro. Ne kwan (orbit) no yɛ kurukuruwa sene okyinnsoromma biara deɛ. Deɛ ɛma Venus yɛ nwanwa ankasa ne sɛdeɛ ɛdane ne ho. Okyinnsoromma no dane ne ho kɔ akyi, anaa retrograde, sɛ yɛde toto akyinnsoromma pii ho a, enti wɔ Venus so no Owia pue wɔ atɔeɛ na ɛtɔ wɔ apueeɛ. Venus san dane ne ho brɛoo ara, ɛgye Asase nna bɛyɛ 243 ansa na ɛdane ne ho pɛnkoro wɔ ne dua (axis) so. Esiane sɛ ne nnanedane no yɛ brɛoo sene n'afe enti, owia da baako wɔ Venus so kyɛ Asase nna bɛyɛ 117, a ɛkyɛ sene n'afe.

Venus wɔ mframa a atwa ho ahyia a ɛyɛ den sene okyinnsoromma a ɛyɛ ɔbotan biara deɛ, a ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 96 yɛ carbon dioxide na omununkum a ɛyɛ sulfuric acid akata ho. Mframa yi kora ɔhyew wɔ runaway greenhouse nsunsuansoɔ mu, na ɛma Venus yɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛyɛ hyew sen biara wɔ owia nhyehyɛeɛ no mu, a ne so ɔhyew bɛn Celsius digrii 465, ɔhyew a ɛbɛtumi anane sumpii (lead). Ne so nhyɛsoɔ no boro Asase deɛ so bɛyɛ mpɛn 92, te sɛ deɛ wowɔ ɛpo ase akyirikyiri. Ne so wɔ ogya mmepɔ (volcanoes), tata akɛseɛ, ne mmepɔ. Venus nni ɔsrane biara na ɛnni ahenkyɛ (rings) nso. Wɔde Romafoɔ abosom-baa a ɔhwɛ ɔdɔ ne ahoɔfɛ so din too no, na Venus hyerɛn sɛ anɔpa ne anwummerɛ nsoromma a ɛyɛ hyerɛn. Ewiem ahyɛn te sɛ Mariner 2, Soviet Venera asiane-hyɛn (landers), ne NASA Magellan orbiter asua ne ho adeɛ.
venus.adult:
Venus ne okyinnsoromma a ɛtɔ so mmienu firi Owia so ne okyinnsoromma a ɛbɛn Asase sen biara, na wɔtaa ka sɛ ɛyɛ Asase ne nua ta ɛfiri sɛ wɔn su akɛseɛ (bulk properties) sɛ wɔn ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nwanwa so. Venus equator ntrɛmu (diameter) bɛyɛ kilomita 12,104, a ɛbɛyɛ Asase ntrɛmu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 95, na ne mu duru bɛyɛ kilogram 4.87 a wɔde du a wɔabɔ ho mpɛn aduonu-nan (10^24) abɔ ho, a ɛbɛyɛ Asase mu duru mpɛn 0.815. Ne density a ɛdɔɔso, a ɛbɛn gram 5.24 wɔ sentimita kubik biara mu, bɛn Asase deɛ, na ne so asase twetwe (gravity) a ɛyɛ mita 8.87 wɔ sekan a wɔabɔ ho mpɛn mmienu no yɛ deɛ yɛte nka wɔ yɛn ankasa okyinnsoromma so no ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 91. Nɔma yi da no adi sɛ ɛyɛ wiase a ɛyɛ ɔbotan, asase-su (terrestrial), a wɔde nneɛma a ɛte sɛ deɛ Asase, Mars, ne Mercury wɔ no ara na ayɛ.

Venus nyaa ne mu bɛyɛ mfeɛ ɔpepepem 4.5 a atwam wɔ owia nebula no emu fa a ɛbɛn mfimfini, baabi a ɔhyew no yɛ kɛseɛ a ɛma dadeɛ ne silicate abotan nko ara na ɛtumi gyina firi mframa ne mfuturo disk a na ɛredwo a atwa Owia a na ɔyɛ abɔfra no ho ahyia no mu. Ɛnam accretion nhyehyɛeɛ so no, planetesimals nketewa a wɔntumi nkan bɔbɔɔ mu na wɔkaa bom, de nkakrankakra sii okyinnsoromma a yɛhunu no ɛnnɛ. Esiane sɛ ɛnyaa ne mu bɛn Owia ne Asase saa enti, Venus nyaa ɔbotan-ne-dadeɛ nsusuansoɔ a ɛsɛ, na ɛkyekyɛɛ mu yɛɛ nkyekyɛmu soronko soronko ɛberɛ a dadeɛ a ɛyɛ duru memee kɔɔ mfimfini na silicate a ɛyɛ hare foroo bɛyɛɛ mantle ne crust no.

Ɛwom sɛ wɔn ahyɛaseɛ yɛ baako deɛ, nanso Venus faa nkɔsoɔ kwan a ɛyɛ soronko koraa so. Ne so no yɛ foforɔ kakra wɔ asase-ho-nimdeɛ (geology) mu, na mmɔnkyi a abɔ (impact craters) a ɛwɔ so no nnɔɔso, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ogya mmepɔ asan asiesie ne so baabiara wɔ mfeɛ ɔpepem ɔhaha pii a atwam yi mu. Tata trɛtrɛɛ a ɛyɛ torotoro, ogya mmepɔ atenten, ne mmeammea a ɛkorɔn na ɛdi ne so nsase no so, ɛberɛ a mframa a ɛmia adeɛ no de nneɛma yi sie firi hwɛ a yɛde ani hwɛ adeɛ no. Sɛ yɛbɛte sɛdeɛ wiase mmienu a wɔn kɛseɛ ne wɔn nneɛma sɛ saa no kɔɔ akwan soronko koraa so, a baako kaa sɛ asase pa a ahye ɛberɛ a Asase deɛ nyinii no ase no, ɛda so ara yɛ nsɛmmisa atitire no mu baako wɔ akyinnsoromma ho nimdeɛ a wɔde toto ho mu, na ɛyɛ adeɛ titire a ɛkanyan yɛn ma yɛkɔ so sua yɛn okyinnsoromma a ɛbɛn yɛn sen biara no ho adeɛ.

---

Venus nante twa Owia ho hyia wɔ akyirikyiri a ɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 108, a ɛne astronomical units 0.72, na ɛde Asase nna 224.7 biara twa ho pɛnkoro. Ne kwan (orbit) no yɛ kurukuruwa wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nwanwa so, na ne eccentricity sua sene okyinnsoromma biara deɛ wɔ owia nhyehyɛeɛ no mu, enti n'akyirikyiri a ɛfiri Owia no nsesa pii koraa wɔ n'afe no nyinaa mu. Nanso okyinnsoromma no nnanedane no yɛ nwanwa kɛseɛ. Venus dane ne ho wɔ ne dua (axis) so kɔ akyi (retrograde), a ɛne akyinnsoromma pii nnanedane ne n'ankasa kwan so nantesoɔ bɔ abira, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ sɛ wowɔ ne so a, Owia bɛpue wɔ atɔeɛ na atɔ wɔ apueeɛ.

Saa nnanedane yi nso yɛ brɛoo kyɛn so, na ɛhia Asase nna bɛyɛ 243 ansa na ɛdane ne ho pɛnkoro, a ɛkyɛ sene okyinnsoromma no afe. Sɛ yɛka nnanedane a ɛkɔ akyi brɛoo yi bɔ ne kwan so nantesoɔ a, owia da baako wɔ Venus so, firi owia-pue baako kɔsi deɛ ɛdi so, kyɛ Asase nna bɛyɛ 117. Venus nni ɔsrane biara na ɛnni ahenkyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ (ring system) nso, su a Mercury nko ara na ɔne no kyɛ wɔ akyinnsoromma no mu. Ne dua no ntwe pii koraa, enti ɛnni mmerɛ-nsakraeɛ (seasons) biara ankasa wɔ ne kwan no nyinaa mu.

Venus wɔ mframa a atwa ho ahyia a ɛmia sene asase-su okyinnsoromma biara deɛ, a ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 96 yɛ carbon dioxide na deɛ aka no mu dodoɔ yɛ nitrogen, na omununkum a ɛyɛ sulfuric acid a ɛwɔ hɔ daa akata so. Mframa nhyɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ ne so no duru bɛyɛ Asase deɛ wɔ ɛpo ani mpɛn 92, a ɛte sɛ nhyɛsoɔ a ɛwɔ ɛpo ase bɛyɛ kilomita baako. Mframa kuntu kɛseɛ yi na ɛde runaway greenhouse nsunsuansoɔ ba a ɛma ne so ɔhyew a ɛdɔɔso no kɔ Celsius digrii bɛyɛ 465, a ɛyɛ hyew sene Mercury ɛwom sɛ Venus wɔ akyirikyiri firi Owia sene no deɛ. Ɔsoro hɔ no, mframa no dane ho ntɛm kyɛn okyinnsoromma no ankasa (super-rotates), na ɛde Asase nna bɛyɛ nan pɛ twa okyinnsoromma no ho hyia. Emu no, wɔgye di sɛ Venus wɔ dadeɛ mfimfini (core), ɔbotan mantle, ne crust, nanso ɛnni wiase nyinaa magnetic field, a ebia ɛfiri ne nnanedane a ɛyɛ brɛoo ne nneɛma a ɛkɔ so wɔ emu no.

---

Venus akyekyere nnipa adwene firi tete berɛ ansa na wɔrekyerɛw abakɔsɛm, ɛfiri sɛ ɛno ne abɔdeɛ a ɛhyerɛn sen biara wɔ anadwo ewiem wɔ Ɔsrane akyi, na yɛtumi de ani kɛkɛ hunu no. Esiane sɛ ɛda adi sɛ hann a ɛhyerɛn wɔ ahemadakye anaa anwummerɛ enti, tete amanfoɔ de din mmienu frɛɛ no, anɔpa nsoromma ne anwummerɛ nsoromma, ansa na nnipa rehunu sɛ ɛyɛ adeɛ baako. Babilonfoɔ de no too abosom-baa Ishtar ho, na Mayafoɔ dii n'akyi a wɔhwɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ yie, nanso din a atena hɔ no firi Romafoɔ hɔ, a wɔhyɛɛ no animuonyam sɛ Venus, wɔn abosom-baa a ɔhwɛ ɔdɔ ne ahoɔfɛ so, a ɛne Helafoɔ deɛ Aphrodite hyia.

Ewiem Mmerɛ (Space Age) no sakraa Venus firi ahintasɛm a ɛhyerɛn kɔyɛɛ wiase a wɔasua ho adeɛ. NASA Mariner 2 bɛyɛɛ ewiem hyɛn a ɛdi kan a ɛtwaa okyinnsoromma foforɔ ho yie ɛberɛ a ɛduruu Venus wɔ 1962, na ɛsii n'ɔhyew a ɛhye no so dua. Soviet Union Venera dwumadie no nyaa nneɛma a ɛdi kan pii, a emu bi ne probe a ɛdi kan a ɛsomaa nsɛm firi okyinnsoromma foforɔ mframa mu ne deɛ ɛdi kan a ɛsiane kɔɔ ne so na ɛde mfoni firi hɔ baeɛ, a ɛgyinaa ɔhyew ne nhyɛsoɔ a ɛyɛ hu no ano simma kakraa bi pɛ. Akyire yi, NASA Magellan orbiter de radar hwiee omununkum no mu na ɛyɛɛ ne so bɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 98 mfoni-kwan (map) pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ 1990 mfeɛ no ahyɛaseɛ mu, ɛberɛ a dwumadie te sɛ Europe Venus Express ne Japan Akatsuki suaa ne mframa ho adeɛ.

Wɔ owia nhyehyɛeɛ no nsiesieɛ mu no, Venus na ɛwɔ kwan a ɛtɔ so mmienu no so na ɛwɔ Owia habitable zone (baabi a nkwa bɛtumi atena) no emu ano, na ɛyɛ nhwɛsoɔ a ɛma yɛdwene sɛdeɛ runaway greenhouse bɛtumi ama wiase a anka ɛbɛtumi ayɛ sɛ Asase ayɛ baabi a nkwa ntumi ntena. Anigyeɛ foforɔ ama wɔahyehyɛ dwumadie foforɔ, a emu bi ne NASA DAVINCI ne VERITAS ne Europe EnVision, a wɔde bɛhwehwɛ n'abakɔsɛm mu. Sɛ Asase okyinnsoromma yɔnko a ɔbɛn no sen biara ne ne nua ta a ɛbɛn so wɔ kɛseɛ mu no, Venus da so ara yɛ abɔdeɛ laboratory a ɛho hia ma yɛde te akyinnsoromma nkɔsoɔ, ewiem tebea (climate), ne tebea a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛma wiase bi yɛ baabi a nkwa tumi tena no ase.

earth.kids: Asase yɛ yɛn fie — ɛhɔ nkoa na yenim sɛ po, mframa, ne nneɛma a nkwa wɔ mu wɔ! Ɛkyinkyim ne ho pɛnkoro da biara na ɛtwa Owia ho hyia pɛnkoro afe biara, na mframa a ɛte sɛ ntoma kata ne ho a ɛma yɛn ho tɔ yɛn pɛpɛɛpɛ.
earth.middle: Asase ne okyinnsoromma a ɛto so abiɛsa a efi Owia so ba, na ɛno nkoa ne wiase a yenim sɛ nkwa wɔ so. Ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ 12,742 km, na nsu a ɛyɛ nsu ankasa kata ne fa kɛse so — bɛyɛ 71% yɛ po — wɔ mframa a ɛyɛ nitrogen ne oxygen a yebetumi ahome no ase. Asase twa Owia ho hyia pɛnkoro wɔ nnafua 365.25 biara mu, na ɛkyinkyim ne ho pɛnkoro wɔ nnɔnhwerew 24 biara mu, na ne mfimfini dua (axis) akyea 23.5°, na ɛno na ɛma yɛn mmerɛ (seasons) no. Magnet tumi (magnetic field) a ɛbɔ yɛn ho ban, a ne dade a anan a ɛwɔ ne mfimfini na ɛyɛ no, bɔ yɛn ho ban fi owia nsunsuanso (solar radiation) a ɛyɛ hu ho. Asase wɔ Ɔsram kɛse baako a ɛma n'akyea no gyina pintinn na ɛma po no bɔ asorɔkye (tides). Ɛwɔ 'beae a nkwa betumi atena' (habitable zone) mu, kwan a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ a nsu betumi aka nsu ankasa — ɛno ne nkwa nyinaa nnyinaso.
earth.high:
Asase ne okyinnsoromma a ɛto so abiɛsa a efi Owia so, na ebesi nnɛ, ɛno nkoa ne wiase a yenim sɛ nkwa wɔ so. Ne mean radius yɛ 6,371 km na ne tɛtrɛtɛ (diameter) yɛ 12,742 km, na ɛno ne okyinnsoromma a ɛso na emu yɛ duru sen biara wɔ abo-okyinnsoromma anan no mu. Nsu a ɛyɛ nsu ankasa kata n'ani bɛyɛ 71% so, na ne mframa a ɛyɛ 78% nitrogen ne 21% oxygen no boa nkwa nneɛma a ɛrenyin yiye (biosphere) wɔ so, bere a ozone ntoma a ɛwɔ soro koraa no siw ultraviolet nsunsuanso a ɛyɛ hu no kwan. Saa po a ɛyɛ nsu ankasa ne mframa a yebetumi ahome a ɛbom yi nyɛ ade a ɛbaa saa kwa, na mmom efi kwan a ɛwɔ Owia ne Asase ntam, mframa no mu nnuru (chemistry), ne ne mu hyew a ɛbom pɛpɛɛpɛ no mu.

Asase twa Owia ho hyia wɔ bɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 150 (150 million kilometers) akyi — kwan a ɛkyerɛ nea wɔfrɛ no astronomical unit — na ewie ne hyia baako nnafua 365.25 biara, bere a ɛkyinkyim ne ho pɛnkoro wɔ nnɔnhwerew 24 biara mu. Saa mfimfini dua no akyea 23.5°, enti bere a okyinnsoromma no nam ne kwan a ɛyɛ kurukuruwa kakra no so no, asase fa ahorow (hemispheres) kyea kɔ Owia so anaa efi ho, na ɛno na ɛde mmerɛ (seasons) no ba. Asase ase, Asase no yɛ ntoma ntoma: mfimfini a emu yɛ den (solid inner core), mfimfini akyi a ɛyɛ nsu (liquid outer core), abo ntam (mantle), ne ne nhoma a ɛyɛ tratraa (crust). Dade a anan a ɛwɔ outer core no mu a ɛkyinkyim (convection) no yɛ adwuma sɛ dynamo a abɔde ankasa yɛ, na ɛyɛ magnet tumi a atwa wiase nyinaa ho hyia a ɛpam owia mframa (solar wind) na ɛboa ma wontumi nyi mframa no mfi so nkɔ wim.

Nea ɛma Asase yɛ soronko ankasa ne sɛnea ɛyɛ adwuma na n'afã ahorow bom. Asase nhoma ahorow a ɛkeka ne ho (plate tectonics) san yɛ nhoma no foforo daa, si mmepɔw, na ɛhwɛ wim tebea so wɔ mfe ɔpepem pii mu denam carbon a ɛde fa ɔbo, po, ne mframa ntam so. Ɔsram kɛse baako, a ebia ɛbae bere a ade bi a ne kɛse te sɛ Mars bɔɔ Asase a na ɛyɛ foforo no bɛyɛ mfe ɔpepepem 4.5 (4.5 billion) a atwam no, ma okyinnsoromma no akyea gyina pintinn na ɛma po asorɔkye (tides) no sɔre. Nkwa nso, asesa okyinnsoromma no: wɔ mfe ɔpepepem pii mu, photosynthesis de oxygen hyɛɛ mframa no mu nkakrankakra. Esiane sɛ ɛwɔ Owia 'beae a nkwa betumi atena' (habitable zone) no mu pɛpɛɛpɛ, kwan a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ a nsu betumi aka nsu ankasa nti, Asase da so yɛ yɛn nhwɛso a eye sen biara na ɛno nkoa a yɛde te nea ɛma wiase bi yɛ nea nkwa betumi atena so ase.
earth.adult:
ABƆDE NE NEA ƐWƆ MU (PHYSICAL & COMPOSITION) — Asase ne okyinnsoromma a ɛso na emu yɛ duru sen biara wɔ abo-okyinnsoromma (terrestrial planets) no mu, na ne mean radius yɛ 6,371 km na ne mu duru (mass) yɛ 5.97×10^24 kg. Gravity ama akyekyɛ mu ayɛ ntoma ntoma a ɛwɔ mfimfini koro: mfimfini a emu yɛ den a ɛyɛ dade ne nickel (solid iron-nickel inner core), mfimfini akyi a ɛyɛ nsu a ɛyɛ dade ne nickel (liquid iron-nickel outer core), silicate ntam a ɛyɛ kɛse (mantle), ne nhoma (crust) a ɛyɛ tratraa kakra a efi kilomita kakraa bi wɔ po ase kosi kilomita du du pii wɔ asasetam akɛse ase. Saa ntoma-ntoma nhyehyɛe yi ne mfiase bere a na ɛnan no kyerɛwtohɔ a agyina pintinn, bere a dade ne nneɛma a emu yɛ duru memem kɔɔ mfimfini na silicate a emu yɛ hare sɔree kɔɔ soro no. Ɛwom sɛ hyew a ɛwɔ mfimfini no ne Owia ani a yehu no sɛ de, nanso mfimfini a ɛwɔ mu no da so yɛ den efisɛ nhyɛso kɛse no ma dade nan-bere hyew (melting point) kɔ soro sen hyew a ɛwɔ hɔ, bere a mfimfini akyi a ɛwɔ soro kakra no da so anan na etumi sen. Emu no da so yɛ hyew, na nneɛma abien na ɛma no tumi: hyew a mfiase no fi nneɛma a ɛboaboaa ano (accretion) ne ade kɛse a ɛbɔɔ no a ɛyɛɛ Ɔsram no akyi, ne radioactive isotopes a ɛkyɛ sɛ uranium, thorium, ne potassium-40 a ɛkɔ so sɛe (decay). Saa hyew a ɛwɔ mu no na ɛma mantle no mu nneɛma a emu yɛ den kyinkyim nkakrankakra (solid-state convection), na ɛno nso na ɛma Asase ani so ade titiriw — plate tectonics — tumi. Lithosphere nhoma ahorow a ɛyɛ den (rigid lithospheric plates) na wɔyɛ no wɔ po mfimfini mmepɔw (mid-ocean ridges) so, ɛtwetwe fa asthenosphere no so, na wɔmene no wɔ subduction beae ahorow, na ɛsan de nhoma no kɔ mantle no mu bio wɔ bɛyɛ mfe ɔpepem ɔha (hundred-million-year) nhyia biara mu. Wiase foforo biara a yenim ntumi nkɔ so nyɛ saa adwuma yi. Asasewosow mframa (seismic waves) a efi asasewosow mu, a ɛkyea na ɛsan ba wɔ saa ntoma ahorow yi mu no, na ɛma geophysicists tumi yɛ emu a emu dɔ a wontumi nkɔ mu nkɔfa nneɛma da no mfoni. Plate tectonics si mmepɔw ne asasetam akɛse (continents), bue po ahorow na ɛtotom, na, nea ɛho hia paa, ɛyɛ carbon-silicate nhyia a ɛkyɛ a ɛhwɛ Asase wim tebea so: silicate abo a ɛsɛe (weathering) twe carbon dioxide fi mframa no mu, bere a ogya mmepɔw (volcanism) san de ba, na ɛyɛ okyinnsoromma no hyew-susudua (planetary thermostat) a ama ani so hyew atena beae a nkwa betumi atena mu mfe ɔpepepem pii. Saa nkitahodi a ɛwɔ emu a ɛyɛ hyew a ɛkyinkyim ne ani a ɛtu na ɛyɛ nnuru adwuma ntam yi na ɛma Asase yɛ nea nkwa wɔ mu wɔ asase-nimdeɛ (geology) mu sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ ɔbo bɔɔl a ɛda hɔ kwa.

---

HYIA, MFRAMA NE TUMI (ORBIT, ATMOSPHERE & FIELD) — Asase twa Owia ho hyia wɔ bɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 150 (150 million kilometers) akyi a wɔsusuw, kwan a ɛkyerɛ astronomical unit no, na ewie hyia baako nnafua 365.25 biara wɔ kwan a ɛyɛ kurukuruwa kakra a ne eccentricity yɛ bɛyɛ 0.017 pɛ so. Ne mfimfini dua a ɛkyinkyim ho no akyea 23.44° wɔ hyia no dan (orbital plane) ho, na saa akyea yi (obliquity) — ɛnyɛ kwan a ɛwɔ hyia no mu a ɛsesa kakra no — ne nea ɛma mmerɛ (seasons) ba ankasa, efisɛ asase fa biara kyea kɔ Owia so na efi ho nnidiso nnidiso afe no mu. Ɔsram gravity ntwitwaso (torque) no ma saa akyea yi gyina pintinn yiye, na ɛma ɛwosow kakraa bi pɛ a ɛma wim tebea no gyina pintinn bere tenten mu. Nea ɛka ho ne Milankovitch nsakrae a ɛba nkakrankakra wɔ nhyia mu wɔ akyea no, hyia no su, ne dua no kwan a ɛkyerɛ mu a ɛhyɛ nhwenesum mmerɛ (ice ages) bere wɔ mfe ɔpem du du pii mu. Mframa a atwa okyinnsoromma no ho hyia no yɛ bɛyɛ 78% nitrogen ne 21% oxygen, ne argon ne greenhouse mframa kakraa bi a carbon dioxide, nsu kutukutu (water vapor), ne methane ka ho. Ɛwom sɛ saa greenhouse nneɛma yi sua wɔ dodow mu de, nanso ɛma ani so hyew a wɔsusuw (mean surface temperature) kɔ bɛyɛ 15 °C — bɛyɛ degree 33 sen nea ade a mframa nni ho a ɛwɔ Asase kwan so bɛyɛ — na ɛma nsu ka nsu ankasa wɔ ani no bɛyɛ 71% so. Wɔ stratosphere soro koraa, ozone ntoma bi twe owia ultraviolet nsunsuanso a anka ebekum nkwa nyinaa wɔ ani so no. Mframa no ankasa yɛ ntoma ntoma, efi troposphere a wim tebea ba mu no kɔ stratosphere, mesosphere, ne thermosphere na ɛyɛ tratraa nkakrankakra kosi sɛ ɛne wim a hwee nni mu (vacuum of space) bɛbom. Nea ɛbɔ nhyehyɛe no nyinaa ho ban ne Asase magnet tumi (magnetic field), a geodynamo a ɛkɔ so n'ankasa na ɛyɛ: nneɛma a ɛkyinkyim (convection) wɔ outer core a ɛyɛ nsu a anyinam tumi fa mu no mu, a okyinnsoromma no kyinkyim a ɛnam Coriolis nsunsuanso so hyehyɛ no, na ɛma anyinam tumi nsuten (electric currents) kɔ so a ɛyɛ dipole tumi a atwa wiase nyinaa ho hyia. Saa magnetosphere yi pam owia mframa (solar wind) mu nneɛma a anyinam tumi wɔ ho (charged particles) no, de wɔn kɔ ntentenso (poles) no so sɛ aurorae, na ɛboa bɔ mframa no ho ban na wɔanhwere no ankɔ wim — ahobammɔ a ɛte sɛ nea Mars, a enni dynamo a ɛyɛ adwuma no, hweree bere tenten a atwam, ne ne mframa no fa kɛse.

---

NKWA, ƆSRAM NE NEA ATWA HO AHYIA (LIFE, MOON & CONTEXT) — Asase nkoa ne wiase a yenim sɛ nkwa wɔ so, na nkwa no sɔree bɛyɛ mfe ɔpepepem 3.7 (3.7 billion) a atwam, wɔ okyinnsoromma no abakɔsɛm mfe ɔpepepem a edi kan no mu. Nkwa antena Asase so kɛkɛ; ɛsesaa no. Photosynthesis a ɛyɛ oxygen (oxygenic photosynthesis), a cyanobacteria na ɛyɛe no, yii oxygen a ɛde ne ho fii adi nkakrankakra a edii kan yɛɛ abo mu nneɛma ne dade a ɛwɔ nsu mu oxidize, na afei, wɔ Great Oxidation Event no mu, ɛboaboaa ano wɔ mframa no mu, na awiei koraa no ɛmaa ozone ntoma no ne metabolism a tumi wɔ mu a nkwa a ɛyɛ den (complex life) gyina so no bae. Efi saa bere no, nkwa nneɛma nyinaa (biosphere) ne okyinnsoromma no ankasa anyin abom, na wɔsesa carbon, oxygen, ne aduan nnuru (nutrients) wɔ geochemical nhyia a abom denneennen mu. Saa nyin a wɔbom nyin no anyɛ nea ɛkɔɔ so dwoodwoo: nneɛma a ayɛ abo (fossil record) no kora nkwa-sɛe akɛse (mass extinctions) bebree a mmoa ne nnua ahorow dodow no ara yerae, na emu biara akyi, nkwa foforo ahorow bae bio, a ɛkyerɛ biosphere a ɛyɛ den na ɛsan gyina nneɛma a ɛba so. Asase Ɔsram kɛse baako no di dwuma a ɛboa nanso ɛho hia. Ne kɛse yɛ bɛyɛ Asase tɛtrɛtɛ nkyem anan mu baako, na ebia ɛbae bɛyɛ mfe ɔpepepem 4.5 (4.5 billion) a atwam bere a protoplanet bi a ne kɛse te sɛ Mars, a wɔtaa frɛ no Theia, bɔɔ Asase a na ɛyɛ foforo (proto-Earth) no na nneɛma a ɛpetee no boaboaa ano wɔ hyia mu — mfiase a Ɔsram mu nneɛma a ɛne Asase mantle no sɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ no foa so. Nnɛ, Ɔsram no ma Asase akyea no gyina pintinn wɔ okyinnsoromma afoforo no gravity ntwetwe ano, na ne gravity ma po asorɔkye (tides) a ɛkanyan mpoano tebea ahorow bere ano bere ano no sɔre, na ebia ɛboaa nkwa mfiase nnuru adwuma (chemistry) no. Ɔsram asorɔkye no nso ma Asase kyinkyim no yɛ brɛoo nkakrankakra, na ɛma da no yɛ tenten, bere a Ɔsram no twe ne ho kɔ akyiri nkakrankakra. Eyinom nyinaa kɔ so efisɛ Asase wɔ Owia 'beae a nkwa betumi atena' (habitable zone) no mu, hyia kwan ahorow a okyinnsoromma bi betumi ama nsu a ɛyɛ nsu ankasa atena n'ani so sɛ ɛwɔ mframa a ɛfata a. Nanso Asase kyerɛ sɛ kwan a ɛfata nkoa nnɔɔso: ɔsram a ɛma ade gyina pintinn, emu a ɛyɛ adwuma, magnet tumi a ɛbɔ ho ban, mframa a ɛhwɛ nneɛma so, ne plate tectonics nyinaa bom ma nkwa tumi tena so. Sɛ yɛte sɛnea saa nhyehyɛe ahorow yi bom yɛ adwuma ase a, ɛma Asase yɛ nhwɛso titiriw a yɛrentumi nnyae wɔ nkwa a yɛhwehwɛ wɔ yɛn owia nhyehyɛe (solar system) akyi no mu.

moon.kids: Ɔsram ne Asase satelaet a efi abɔde mu a ɛwɔ hɔ koro pɛ, abotan wiase a etwa yɛn ho hyia bɛyɛ pɛnkoro bosome biara. Ne twetwe na ɛma po no asorɔkye foro na ɛsan ba fam, na ɛkyerɛ yɛn n'anim koro no ara bere nyinaa!
moon.middle: Ɔsram ne Asase satelaet a efi abɔde mu a ɛwɔ hɔ koro pɛ, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ bɛyɛ 3,474 km — bɛyɛ Asase tɛtrɛtɛ no nkyekyɛmu anan mu baako. Ɛtwa yɛn ho hyia nnafua 27.3 biara, na esiane sɛ ɛdannan ne ho pɛnkoro wɔ ahyiahyia biara mu (tidal locking, asorɔkye nkyekyere) nti, ɛkyerɛ Asase n'afã a ɛbɛn yɛn no ara bere nyinaa. Owia hann a ɛhyerɛn Ɔsram afã ahorow bere a ɛretwa yɛn ho ahyia no na ɛma yenya Ɔsram gyinabea ahorow (phases) no — foforo, kɔntɔnkurowi (crescent), nkyekyɛmu anan mu baako (quarter), gibbous (a ɛboro fa), ne mma (full) — wɔ bɛyɛ nnafua 29.5 mu. Ɔsram nni mframa (atmosphere) biara koraa, enti ne soro a ɛyɛ nsonso (grey) a amena akɛse (craters), mmepɔw, ne 'po' tuntum a ɛyɛ abotan a anan (lava) — a wɔfrɛ no maria — wɔ so no nsesae wɔ mfe ɔpepepem pii mu, na ɛda so ara kura ahunmu akwantufo (astronauts) anammɔn. N'adesoa (gravity) twe Asase po ahorow ma ɛyɛ asorɔkye, na ɛma Asase sɛw no gyina pintinn nkakrankakra, ma yɛn wim tebea (climate) yɛ pintinn.
moon.high:
Ɔsram ne Asase satelaet a efi abɔde mu a ɛwɔ hɔ koro pɛ, na ɛyɛ ɔsram a ɛto so anum wɔ kɛse mu wɔ owia nsiesiei (solar system) no mu; ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ kilomita 3,474 — bɛyɛ Asase tɛtrɛtɛ nkyekyɛmu anan mu baako, nanso ne mu duru yɛ Asase de no nkyekyɛmu aduɔwɔtwe baako (81) mu baako pɛ. Nyansahufo de giant-impact nsusuwii (ɔhwe kɛse ho nsusuwii) no kyerɛ ne awo mu: bɛyɛ mfe ɔpepepem 4.5 a atwam ni, wiase bi a ne kɛse te sɛ Mars a wɔfrɛ no Theia bɔɔ Asase a na ɛyɛ foforo no mu, na nkunkumma a ɛtow guu ahyiahyia kwan so no boaboaa ano bɛyɛɛ Ɔsram. Saa ahyɛase no kyerɛ nea enti a Ɔsram abo te sɛ Asase mantle (Asase mu afã a ɛwɔ ntam) no pɛpɛɛpɛ, a dade kokoam (core) ketewaa bi pɛ na ɛwɔ emu. Bere a Ɔsram foforo no dwoe no, abotan a anan no po bi yɛɛ den bɛyɛɛ ne mmepɔw atenten a ɛyɛ fitaa (highlands) no, na akyiri yi basalt lava tuntum a anan guu amena akɛse a ɔhwe de bae mu bɛyɛɛ 'po' a ɛyɛ trontrom, anaa maria, a yɛda so hu no nnɛ.

Ɔsram ayɛ tidally locked (asorɔkye nkyekyere), ɛdannan ne ho pɛnkoro wɔ ahyiahyia a ɛyɛ nnafua 27.3 biara mu, enti afã a ɛbɛn yɛn no ara na ɛkyerɛ yɛn bere nyinaa — nanso nwosow bi a wɔfrɛ no libration ma yetumi hu ne soro no bɛyɛ ɔha mu 59 (59 percent) bere tenten mu. Bere a owia hann hyerɛn ɔsram prɛte no afã ahorow no, yehu gyinabea ahorow a yenim no — foforo, kɔntɔnkurowi, nkyekyɛmu anan mu baako, gibbous, ne mma — a ɛsan ba nnafua 29.5 biara. Esiane sɛ Ɔsram nni mframa (atmosphere) biara koraa nti, ne soro a amena akɛse wɔ so no nsesae, na ɛkora mfe ɔpepepem pii abakɔsɛm ne ahunmu akwantufo anammɔn mpo. Ɔhyew ne awɔw yɛ den yiye, efi bɛyɛ +120 °C wɔ owia hann mu kosi −130 °C anadwo, bere a amena a sunsuma wɔ mu daa a ɛbɛn ne ntwea (poles) no yɛ nwini araa sɛ ɛbɛkora nsukyenee (water ice).

Ɔsram adesoa (gravity) ne ade titiriw a ɛma Asase po asorɔkye, na saa asorɔkye twe koro no ara ma Asase dannan brɛ nkakrankakra, na ɛpia Ɔsram kɔ akyiri bɛyɛ sentimita 3.8 afe biara — nsakrae a wɔde ahwehwɛ a ahunmu akwantufo gyaw wɔ hɔ no susuw. Ɔsram san ma Asase sɛw (axial tilt) gyina pintinn, na ɛboa ma yɛn wim tebea yɛ pintinn sɛnea nkwa betumi atena. Nnipa dii kan nantew ne soro wɔ Apollo akwantu ahorow no mu wɔ 1969 kosi 1972, na wɔde abo nhwɛso bae a ɛyɛ owia nsiesiei no bere nhyehyɛe no nnyinaso. Afei bere foforo a robot ne nnipa Artemis akwantu ahorow de wɔn ani asi anafo ntwea a nsu pii wɔ hɔ no so, na wɔwɔ anidaso sɛ wɔbɛma nnipa atena hɔ daa wɔ Asase akyi.
moon.adult:
AHYƐASE NE NEA ƐDE AYƐ — Ɔsram yɛ abotan wiase a wɔakyekyɛ ne mu (differentiated) a ne radius yɛ kilomita 1,737 na ne mu duru yɛ bɛyɛ Asase de nkyekyɛmu aduɔwɔtwe baako (81) mu baako, na ɛno ma ɛyɛ satelaet a efi abɔde mu a ɛto so anum wɔ kɛse mu wɔ owia nsiesiei no mu, na sɛ wɔde toto okyini (planet) a ɛkura no no ho a, ɛso wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ daa. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wogye tom pii wɔ ne nyɛe ho ne giant-impact nsusuwii (ɔhwe kɛse ho nsusuwii) no: bɛyɛ mfe ɔpepepem 4.5 a atwam ni, proto-okyini bi a ne kɛse te sɛ Mars a wɔtaa frɛ no Theia bɔɔ proto-Asase no mu, na nkunkumma a ayɛ huhuw ne nea anan a ɛtow guu ahyiahyia kwan so no boaboaa ano nkakrankakra bɛyɛɛ Ɔsram. Saa nsusuwii yi kyerɛ nneɛma pii a wɔahu mu wɔ bere koro fɛfɛɛfɛ — Ɔsram mu nneɛma a ɛtumi yɛ huhuw ntɛm (volatile elements) ne dade a ɛyɛ kakraa bi, ne mu nneɛma nyinaa a ɛne Asase silicate mantle no hyia pɛpɛɛpɛ, ne Asase–Ɔsram nsiesiei no angular momentum (ahyiahyia tumi). Nea ɛho hia paa ne sɛ, oxygen-isotope ratio a ɛwɔ Ɔsram nhwɛso mu no ne Asase so abotan de no nsonsonoe nni mu koraa, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ Theia ne Asase a edi kan no nyaa fibea koro anaasɛ ɔhwe no frafraa wiase abien no nyinaa yiye. Esiane sɛ dade a ɛbɔɔ mu no mu dodow no ara memem kɔɔ Asase mu anaa ɛyerae nti, Ɔsram kura dade kokoam (metallic core) ketewaa bi pɛ, na ɛma ne mu duru nyinaa (density) sũ sɛ wɔde toto terrestrial okyini ahorow no ho a. Boaboa-ano no akyi no, Ɔsram akyi fã no yɛɛ hyew araa ma magma po (abotan a anan) kataa ne nyinaa so. Bere a saa abotan a anan no dwoe na ɛyɛɛ den no, plagioclase feldspar a ne mu duru sũ no foro kɔɔ soro na ɛyɛɛ den bɛyɛɛ anorthosite crust (abotan ahoma) a ɛhyerɛn a ɛyɛ tete mmepɔw atenten (highlands) a amena akɛse pii wɔ so a yɛda so hu no nnɛ. Nneɛma a emu duru kyɛn no memem kɔɔ fam, na ɛkyekyɛɛ ne mu yɛɛ crust, mantle, ne core. Mfe ɔpepem ɔhaha pii akyi no, ɔhyew a efi radioactive mu maa fã bi nan wɔ fam tɔnn, na basalt lava a ɛsen ntɛm (low-viscosity) tu fii mu pii hyɛɛ amena akɛse a ɔhwe de bae no ase wɔ afã a ɛbɛn yɛn no mu ma. Saa basalt asase tamaa tuntum a dade wom pii yi ne maria — Latin kasa mu 'po' — a ɛma ɔsram mma no anim a yenim no. Enti nsonsonoe kɛse a ɛda mmepɔw atenten a ɛhyerɛn ne maria tuntum no ntam no kyerɛ Ɔsram abakɔsɛm ti abien a ɛsono emu biara: mfiase crust a wɔde fii magma po mu sii, na nea edi so ne ogya a etu bere ne bere mu (volcanism) a adwo kɛse wɔ mfe ɔpepepem a atwam no mu.

---

AHYIAHYIA NE NE KANKYEE — Ɔsram twa Asase ho hyia wɔ akyirikyiri a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 384,000 wɔ nkyɛmu mu, na ne dannan no akyekyere wɔ baako-ne-baako, anaa synchronous, resonance (nsiesiei a ɛne ne ahyiahyia no hyia) mu — asorɔkye tumi (tidal forces) a bere tenten a atwam no maa Ɔsram dannan brɛɛ kosii sɛ ne dannan bere ne ne ahyiahyia bere yɛɛ pɛ no ho aba pa ara. Nea efi mu ba ne sɛ, afã koro no ara na ɛkyerɛ Asase daa, na afã a ɛwɔ akyiri (far side) no, obiara anhu da kosii sɛ ahunmu hyɛn twaa ne mfonini wɔ 1959. Nanso nkyekyere no nyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ: esiane sɛ Ɔsram ahyiahyia kwan no yɛ ntwetwemu (elliptical) na ɛkyea nti, ne gyinabea a yehu no wosow wɔ kankyee bi a wɔfrɛ no libration mu, na ɛno ma wɔn a wɔhwɛ fi Asase so tumi hu Ɔsram soro no bɛyɛ ɔha mu 59 (59 percent) wɔ bosome biara mu. Bere abien a ɛsono emu biara na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ Ɔsram nhyehyɛe no mu. Sidereal bosome a ɛyɛ nnafua 27.3 no ne bere a ɛde wie ahyiahyia baako sɛ wɔde toto nsoromma a wogyina pintinn no ho, bere a synodic bosome a ɛyɛ nnafua 29.5 no yɛ bere a ɛda gyinabea (phase) koro ne bi a ɛte saa ara ntam; abien yi nyɛ pɛ efisɛ Asase ankasa kɔ n'anim wɔ n'owia ahyiahyia kwan so, enti ɛsɛ sɛ Ɔsram tu kwan kakra kɔ akyiri ansa na Owia, Asase, ne Ɔsram asan ahyia wɔ ntrɛmu koro mu. Saa nhyehyɛe koro yi na ɛde owia ne ɔsram nkata (eclipses) ba: owia nkata (solar eclipse) bere a ɔsram foforo no twa Asase ne Owia ntam tẽẽ, ne ɔsram nkata (lunar eclipse) bere a ɔsram mma no hyɛn Asase sunsuma mu. Nkata nsi bosome biara efisɛ Ɔsram ahyiahyia kwan no kyea bɛyɛ digrii anum, enti ahyiahyia no yɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ beae a ɛbɛn nodes (ntwa nkwan) no nkutoo. Esiane sɛ ahyiahyia kwan no nyɛ kurukuruwa nti, Ɔsram kɛse a yehu no sesa wɔ perigee (beae a ɛbɛn Asase pa ara) ne apogee (beae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri pa ara) ntam, na ɛde nsonsonoe a ɛda 'supermoon' ne prɛte ketewa a ebetumi ama owia nkata ayɛ annular (kaa a ɛyɛ nhoma) sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ nea ɛkata ne nyinaa so (total) no ba. Wɔ adesoa (gravity) fam no, Ɔsram ma asorɔkye nhonhom (tidal bulges) sɔre wɔ Asase po ahorow ne n'ankasa nipadua a ɛyɛ den no mu; ntwetwe (friction) twe saa nhonhom yi di Asase–Ɔsram ntrɛmu no anim, na ɛde angular momentum kɔ akyiri. Nea efi mu ba no, wotumi susuw: Asase dannan no regyina nkakrankakra, na ɛma da no yɛ tenten, bere a Ɔsram twe ne ho kɔ akyiri bɛyɛ sentimita 3.8 afe biara — nsakrae a wɔde laser susuw akyirikyiri kɔ retroreflectors (ahwehwɛ a ɛsan hann) a Apollo ahunmu akwantufo gyaw wɔ hɔ no so de asi so dua.

---

TEBEA NE NHWEHWƐMU — Sɛ́ anka ɛbɛyɛ mframa (atmosphere) ankasa no, Ɔsram wɔ exosphere a ɛyɛ hare pɛ — beae a ɛbɛn vacuum (hwee nni mu) a atom kakraa bi wɔ mu a ɛyɛ hare araa ma emu nneɛma ketewaa no ntaa nhyia. Esiane sɛ mframa biara nni hɔ a ɛbɛkyekyɛ ɔhyew, nsu a ɛsen nni hɔ, na wim nsakrae (weather) nni hɔ nti, ne soro hyia ɔhyew ne awɔw a emu yɛ den yiye, a ɔhyew ne awɔw no ntam nsonsonoe yɛ bɛyɛ Celsius digrii 250 wɔ Ɔsram awia, baabi a owia hann wɔ no foro kɔ +120 °C, ne anadwo a awɔw wom a ɛkɔ fam kosi bɛyɛ −130 °C no ntam. Esiane sɛ ɔsɛe (erosion) biara nni hɔ nti, ɔhwe ahorow, lava a ɛsen, ne ahunmu akwantufo mpaboa anammɔn mpo da hɔ bɛyɛ daa, na ɛdan ne soro no yɛ owia nsiesiei abakɔsɛm adekorabea a mframa nsɛee no a wɔakyerɛw wɔ n'amena akɛse ho kyerɛwtohɔ mu. Micrometeoroids (abo nketenkete a efi wim) ne owia ne wim hyerɛn (solar and cosmic radiation) a ɛbɔ no daa, a magnetic field (dade tumi) biara a ɛkata ne nyinaa so mmɔ ho ban no, ayam ne soro atifi pa ara ayɛ no regolith (mfutuma) a ɛyɛ muhumuhu na ɛyɛ hwinhwin a ɛkata abotan a ɛwɔ fam no so. Saa komm koro no ara ma ade a ɛho hia yiye tumi tena hɔ: wɔ amena a sunsuma wɔ mu daa a ɛbɛn ntwea (poles) no, baabi a owia hann nnu da no, awɔw no mu yɛ den a ɛbɛkora nsukyenee (water ice) a comets ne micrometeorites de bae wɔ mfe mpempem pii mu. Saa nsukyenee yi ho hia wɔ nyansahu mu sɛ kyerɛwtohɔ a ayɛ nsukyenee, na ɛho hia wɔ nneyɛe mu sɛ nsu a wɔnom, oxygen, ne rocket ngo (propellant) fibea a ebetumi aba ama akwantu a ɛbɛba daakye. Nnipa nhwehwɛmu duu ne sorokɔ a ɛyɛ abakɔsɛm wɔ Apollo nhyehyɛe no mu: nnipa sii hɔ mpɛn asia wɔ 1969 kosi 1972, na wɔde abo ne dɔte bɛyɛ kilogram 382 bae, nhwɛso a wɔn mfe a wɔasusuw no pɛpɛɛpɛ no na wɔde siesie amena akɛse mmere nhyehyɛe (cratering chronology) a wɔde bu asase ani ahorow mfe wɔ owia nsiesiei no mu fã (inner solar system) nyinaa. Mfe du du pii a robot ahunmu hyɛn nkutoo na ɛkɔɔ hɔ akyi no, bere foforo rekɔ so. NASA Artemis nhyehyɛe no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛsan de ahunmu akwantufo akɔ ne soro — saa bere yi de, wɔde wɔn ani asi anafo ntwea a nsu pii wɔ hɔ no so — bere a amanaman ntam ne adwumakuw ahorow robot hyɛn a wɔn dodow rekɔ soro no rehwehwɛ nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ na wɔresɔ mfiridwuma ahwɛ. Wɔn botae a wɔn nyinaa kura no nyɛ nsrahwɛ tiawa bio, na mmom ɛyɛ nnipa a wɔbɛtena hɔ daa, a wɔde Ɔsram bɛyɛ nyansahu atenae ne beae a wɔsɔ nneɛma hwɛ ma akwantu a wɔbɛtu akɔ Mars.

mars.kids: Mars ne okyinnsoromma kɔkɔɔ no; dade nkanna a ɛwɔ ne mfutuma mu na ɛma ɛyɛ kɔkɔɔ. Ɛwɔ mmepɔw ogya akɛse, ɔbon a ɛware sen ɔman bi, ne mfiri (robots) a wɔrehwehwɛ mu seesei ara sɛ wobehu tete nsu ho nsɛnkyerɛnne!
mars.middle: Mars yɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛto so anan fi Owia no, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ Asase de no fa pɛɛ (6,779 km). Ɛhwɛ kɔkɔɔ efisɛ ne dɔte ahyɛ dade nkanna a wɔfrɛ no iron oxide ma. Mars wɔ mframa teateaa a ɛyɛ carbon dioxide, enti awɔw wom — ne hyew a ɛtaa wɔ hɔ bɛyɛ −60 °C — na mfutuma ahum betumi akata okyinnsoromma no nyinaa so. Mars da koro bɛn yɛn de (nnɔnhwerew 24 ne simma 37), nanso afe koro yɛ Asase nna 687. Ɛkura bepɔw ogya a ɛware sen biara wɔ owia-nsoromma-kuw no mu, Olympus Mons (bɛyɛ 22 km sorokɔ), ne ɔbon nkwanta kɛse, Valles Marineris, a ɛbɛtwa United States no nyinaa mu. Nsubɔnten ne nsutae a ayow kyerɛ sɛ nsu a ɛsen tenaa hɔ bere bi, na ɛno nti na rovers te sɛ Perseverance hwehwɛ tete nkwa ho nsɛnkyerɛnne wɔ Mars so. Ɛwɔ ɔsram nketewa abien, Phobos ne Deimos.
mars.high:
Mars yɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛto so anan fi Owia no, na ɛyɛ nea esua to so abien wɔ yɛn owia-nsoromma-kuw no mu. Ne tɛtrɛtɛ (diameter) yɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 6,779, enti ɛyɛ Asase kɛse no fa pɛɛ. Ne mu duru (mass) yɛ Asase de no nkyekyɛmu du mu baako pɛ, enti asase-twe (gravity) a ɛwɔ ne so yɛ ɔha mu 38 pɛ wɔ nea yɛte wɔ fie no — onipa a ne duru yɛ pɔn 100 bɛyɛ pɔn 38 pɛ wɔ Mars so. Ne nyinaa akyi no, Mars yɛ abotan wiase (terrestrial) te sɛ Asase, a wɔde dade ne ɔbo na ayɛ, na ɛnyɛ mframa. Okyinnsoromma yi agye din wɔ ne kɔkɔɔ ho, a efi iron oxide, anaa nkanna, a ɛkata ne abotan ani ne ne mfutuma nketenkete so. Eyi nti, Mars anya abodin "Okyinnsoromma Kɔkɔɔ no."

Mars twa Owia no ho hyia wɔ akyirikyiri a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 228 (million) — Asase de no mmɔho 1.5 — na egye Asase nna 687 ansa na ɛtwa Owia no ho pɛnkoro. Mars da koro, a wɔfrɛ no sol, yɛ bɛyɛ nnɔnhwerew 24 ne simma 37, a ɛbɛn Asase da ankasa. Mars akyea wɔ ne dua (axis) so bɛyɛ degree 25, a ɛte sɛ Asase degree 23.5 akyea no ara, na ɛno kyerɛ sɛ okyinnsoromma no nya mmere (seasons). Da tenten ne akyea a ɛhyia saa no ma Mars yɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛte sɛ Asase pa ara wɔ nea yenim nyinaa mu. Nanso, esiane sɛ ne kwan a ɛfa so ware nti, Mars bere biara kyɛ bɛyɛ yɛn de no mmɔho abien.

Mars mframa yɛ teateaa na carbon dioxide na ɛdɔɔso wom, na mframa-mia (pressure) a ɛwɔ ne so nnu Asase de no ɔha mu baako, enti nsu a ɛsen ntumi ntena ne so nnɛ. Mars kura Olympus Mons, bepɔw ogya a ɛware sen biara wɔ owia-nsoromma-kuw no mu a ne sorokɔ yɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 22, ne Valles Marineris, ɔbon nkwanta a ne tenten yɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 4,000. Ɔsram nketewa abien, Phobos ne Deimos, twa okyinnsoromma no ho hyia. Wɔde Roma ɔko nyame no din too no esiane ne mogya-kɔkɔɔ ho nti, na mfiri-akwantufo pii akɔsra Mars, a NASA rovers te sɛ Perseverance ne Curiosity ka ho, a wɔhwehwɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia nkwa nketenkete (microbial) tenaa hɔ bere bi.
mars.adult:
Mars, okyinnsoromma a ɛto so anan fi Owia no, yɛ abotan wiase (terrestrial) a ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ Asase de no fa pɛɛ, na ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 6,779, anaasɛ ne radius yɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 3,390. Ne mu duru a ɛyɛ 6.42 × 10^23 kilogram yɛ Asase de no ɔha mu dubaako pɛ, na ne density a ɛba fam ne ne kɛse a esua no bom ma asase-twe a ɛwɔ ne so yɛ mita 3.72 wɔ sekan biara mu mprenu (3.72 meters per second squared) — bɛyɛ Asase twe no ɔha mu 38. Onipa a ne duru yɛ pɔn 100 wɔ Asase so bɛyɛ pɔn 38 pɛ wɔ Mars so. Te sɛ Mercury, Venus, ne Asase no, Mars yɛ abotan okyinnsoromma a silicate abo, nnade, ne nneɛma foforo na wɔde ayɛ no titiriw, na ɛno na ɛma ɛsono no fi mframa ne nsukyenee akɛse (gas and ice giants) a ɛwɔ owia-nsoromma-kuw no akyi no ho.

Mars agye din paa wɔ ne nkanna-kɔkɔɔ ho, a efi iron oxide — nkanna ankasa — a ahyɛ ne dɔte ne ne mfutuma a ɛwɔ mframa mu no ma. Saa ahosu yi ama okyinnsoromma no ayɛ fɛ ama nnipa a wɔhwɛ no fi tete. Mars ani yɛ nneɛma a ɛboro so: ɛkura Olympus Mons, bepɔw ogya a ɛso sen biara wɔ owia-nsoromma-kuw no mu, a ɛpagyaw ne ho bɛyɛ kilomita 22 fi tataw a atwa ho ahyia no so, a ɛbɛyɛ Bepɔw Everest sorokɔ no mmɔho abiɛsa. Ɛsan kura Valles Marineris, ɔbon nkwanta kɛse a ne tenten yɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 4,000 — a ɛware a ɛbɛtwa United States asase no nyinaa mu — na ne bun kɔ fam kodu kilomita 7.

Wosusuw sɛ Mars baa mu bɛyɛ mfe ɔpepepem 4.6 (billion) a atwam, ɛne owia-nsoromma-kuw no nkae no nyinaa, denam mfutuma ne abo a ɛboaboaa ano wɔ protoplanetary disk a atwa Owia no a na ɛyɛ ɔbabun no ho ahyia no mu. Ne kɛse a esua no kyerɛ sɛ ɛdwoo ntɛm sen Asase, na ne mu nneyɛe nso faa ɔkwan foforo so. Adanse a orbiters ne rovers aboaboa ano kyerɛ sɛ na tete Mars yɛ hyew na ɛyɛ fɔkyee, a na nsubɔnten, nsutae, ne ebia ɛpo wɔ atifi fam, ansa na ɛrehwere ne mframa ne ne so nsu no pii wɔ mfe ɔpepepem pii mu. Saa nsakrae yi a efi tete wiase a anka nkwa betumi atena mu kɔ sare awɔw a yehu nnɛ no ma Mars yɛ botae a ɛfata ma okyinnsoromma nkɔso ne tebea a ehia ma nkwa ho adesua.

---

Mars twa Owia no ho hyia wɔ akyirikyiri a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ kilomita ɔpepem 227.9, a ɛyɛ astronomical unit 1.52, na etwa ho pɛnkoro wɔ Asase nna 687 biara mu — ɛbɛn Asase mfe abien pɛɛ. Ne kwan no yɛ elliptical (ɛkyea sen kurukuruwa) kyɛn Asase de no koraa, na ɛno ma ne kwan a ɛwɔ Owia no ho no sesa kɛse, na ɛboa ma mmere (seasons) nsonsonoe a ɛda atifi fam ne anafo fam ntam no yɛ den. Mars da koro, a wɔfrɛ no sol, yɛ bɛyɛ nnɔnhwerew 24 ne simma 37, a ɛne Asase ntwaho bere no sɛ paa. Okyinnsoromma no dua akyea a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ degree 25.2, a ɛbɛn Asase degree 23.5 no, ma mmere anan ba, nanso emu biara kyɛ bɛyɛ Asase de no mmɔho abien.

Mars wɔ ɔsram nketewa abien a wɔn ho nyɛ pɛ, Phobos ne Deimos, a ebia wɔyɛ asteroids a wɔkyekyeree wɔn anaa tete ɔbɔ bi mu nsɛe. Phobos, nea ɛso na ɛbɛn no, twa ho hyia bɛn ne so no ara sɛ nkakrankakra ɛrekɔ mu, na awiei koraa no ɛbɛpaapae anaa ɛbɛhwe okyinnsoromma no so wɔ mfe ɔpepem du du bi mu. Mars nni nkaa (ring) biara nnɛ, nanso Phobos a ɛbɛpaapae daakye no betumi ama nkaa a ɛntena hɔ daa aba. Mars mframa yɛ teateaa, a bɛyɛ ɔha mu 95 yɛ carbon dioxide, a nitrogen ne argon kakra ka ho, na mia (pressure) a ɛde ba ne so nnu Asase de wɔ ɛpo ani no ɔha mu baako.

Saa mframa teateaa yi ntumi nkura hyew pii, enti ɔhyew ne awɔw sesa kɛse, a ɛtaa yɛ bɛyɛ minus 60 degree Celsius na ɛkɔ fam koraa wɔ ahyɛase afã (poles) no ho. Mars agye din wɔ mfutuma ahum a ɛkata okyinnsoromma no nyinaa so a etumi kata n'ani nnawɔtwe pii. Ne abon (crust) no ase na mantle ne core a ɛyɛ den a iron, nickel, ne sulfur ahyɛ mu ma wɔ, sɛnea seismic data a efi NASA InSight lander no asi so dua no. Ɛnte sɛ Asase, Mars nni magnetic field a ɛkata ne nyinaa so nnɛ, efisɛ ɛhweree ne mu dynamo no bere tenten ni — ɔhwere a ɛmaa owia mframa (solar wind) tutuu ne tete mframa no mu pii kɔe. Saa nneɛma yi nyinaa bom da okyinnsoromma bi a ne mu afiri no dum ntɛm adi, na ɛsakraa ne wim tebea ne ne nkwa-tena-mu-tumi wɔ geological bere mu.

---

Mars afa adesamma adwene mfe mpempem pii ni. Ne mogya-kɔkɔɔ hwɛbea maa tete aman pii de no bataa ɔko, ogya, ne ntawntaw ho. Romafo de wɔn ɔko nyame Mars din too no, na Hellafo frɛɛ no Ares. Babilon nsoromma-hwɛfo de no bataa Nergal, wɔn ɔko ne ɔyaredɔm nyame no ho, na aman foforo wɔ Misraim, China, ne India hwɛɛ ne nantew soronko wɔ anadwo wim. Esiane sɛ Mars yɛ te sɛ nea ɛresan n'akyi bere bi — ade a wɔfrɛ no retrograde motion — nti, ɛhaw tete nsoromma-hwɛfo, na ɛdii dwuma titiriw wɔ owia-nsoromma-kuw ho nhwɛso (models) nkɔso mu, a Johannes Kepler okyinnsoromma nantew ho mmara, a wonyaa no fi Mars kwan ho nhwehwɛmu a wɔde ahwɛyiye yɛe mu no ka ho.

Mars nhwehwɛmu bere foforo no fii ase wɔ 1960 mfe no mu. NASA Mariner 4 yɛɛ flyby a edii yiye a edi kan wɔ 1965, na ɛde okyinnsoromma foforo ho mfonini a wɔtwaa no bɛn a edi kan bae. Mariner 9 bɛyɛɛ wim-hyɛn a edi kan a ɛtwaa Mars ho hyiae wɔ 1971, na Viking landers no sii fam wɔ 1976, na wɔyɛɛ nsɔhwɛ a edi kan a ɛhwehwɛ nkwa. Efi saa bere no, orbiters, landers, ne rovers a wɔdi wɔn ho akyi — a Pathfinder, Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity, ne Perseverance ka ho — asakra yɛn ntease, na ada tete nsubɔnten, abo adanse a ɛkyerɛ nsu a na ɛwɔ hɔ kan, ne geology a emu yɛ den adi. Perseverance reboaboa abo nhwɛso ano seesei a wɔayɛ adwene sɛ wɔde bɛsan aba Asase so daakye, bere a Ingenuity helicopter no yɛɛ tu a ɛde tumi tu a edi kan wɔ wiase foforo so.

Sɛ okyinnsoromma anan a ɛyɛ abotan no mu nea ɛwɔ akyi koraa no, Mars wɔ gyinabea a ɛho hia wɔ owia-nsoromma-kuw no mu, na ɛte Asase akyi pɛɛ ne asteroid belt a ɛtetew wiase a ɛwɔ mu ne mframa akɛse (gas giants) no ntam no mu. Wobu no sɛ ɛne beae a ɛfata sen biara ma daakye nnipa nhwehwɛmu ne tenabea, esiane ne tebea a ɛyɛ mmerɛw kakra, ne so a wotumi du ho, ne nsu a na ɛwɔ hɔ kan ho adanse nti. Wim-adwumakuw ne ankorankoro adwumakuw nyinaa reyɛ nhyehyɛe ma akwantu a nnipa wɔ mu wɔ mfe du du a ɛreba no mu, na ɛno ma Mars nyɛ okyinnsoromma abakɔsɛm ho mfɛnsere nko, na mmom ɛyɛ ofie a ɛto so abien a ebetumi aba ma adesamma.

jupiter.kids: Jupiter ne okyinnsoromma a ɛso sen biara — ɛso ara sɛ okyinnsoromma a aka nyinaa betumi akɔ ne mu! Ɛyɛ mframa kurukuruwa kɛse a ahum bi a wɔfrɛ no Great Red Spot wɔ so, na saa ahum no so sen Asase nyinaa.
jupiter.middle: Jupiter ne okyinnsoromma a ɛso sen biara; ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ 143,000 km — wubetumi de Asase a ɛboro 1,300 ahyɛ ne mu. Ɛyɛ mframa okyinnsoromma kɛse (gas giant) a hydrogen ne helium na wɔde ayɛ ne fã kɛse no ara, na enni asase den biara a wubetumi agyina so. Jupiter kyinkyini ntɛm sen okyinnsoromma foforo biara; ɛkyinkyini pɛnkoro wɔ nnɔnhwerew 10 ase, na eyi ma ne mfinimfini (equator) no hono na ɛma ne mununkum no yɛ nsensanee a ɛwɔ ahosu ahorow. N'ahum a agye din a wɔfrɛ no Great Red Spot no yɛ ahum a ɛso sen Asase a abɔ mfeha pii ni. Jupiter wɔ magnet tumi (magnetic field) a ɛyɛ den ne ɔsram a wonim no bɛyɛ 95 anaa nea ɛboro saa, a ɔsram akɛse anan a wɔfrɛ wɔn 'Galilean' ɔsram no — Io, Europa, Ganymede, ne Callisto — ka ho. Europa de po a nkyene wom asie wɔ ne nsukyenee ahoɔden ase — baabi a anidaso wɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ nkwa wɔ hɔ.
jupiter.high:
Jupiter ne okyinnsoromma a ɛso sen biara wɔ owia nsoromma kuw (solar system) no mu; ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ kilomita 139,820 na ne duru boro okyinnsoromma a aka nyinaa a wɔaka abom. Ɛyɛ mframa okyinnsoromma kɛse (gas giant) a hydrogen bɛyɛ ɔha mu 90 ne helium ɔha mu 10 na wɔde ayɛ, afrafra a ɛte sɛ Owia no ankasa pɛpɛɛpɛ. Jupiter nni asase den biara a wubetumi agyina so. Mmom, bere a wɔkɔ fam no, wɔmia n'akyi nsensanee no hydrogen mframa no kɔ po kɛse a ɛyɛ liquid metallic hydrogen mu wɔ nhyɛso a ɛyɛ hu ase, na ebia ɛtwa mfinimfini (core) a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a nnɔɔso a emu yɛ duru no afã bi anan wɔ mu no ho hyia. Nea ɛyɛ nwonwa ne sɛ, Jupiter da so ara ma ahoɔden a ɛboro nea onya fi Owia no bɛyɛ mpɛn 1.6 — ɛgyaa ɔhyew a aka fi ne bɔ no mu bere a ɛrebɔ mu nkakrankakra.

Okyinnsoromma no kyinkyini pɛnkoro wɔ nnɔnhwerew 10 ase, ntɛm sen okyinnsoromma foforo biara; nkyinkyini a ɛyɛ ntɛm saa no ma Jupiter yɛ tɛtrɛtɛ wɔ ne ti ne n'ase (poles) na ɛhono wɔ ne mfinimfini (equator). Saa nkyinkyini yi hyehyɛ ne wim mframa no ma ɛyɛ ammonia mununkum nsensanee a ɛhyerɛn (zones) ne nea ɛyɛ tuntum (belts) a edi so adi so, a mframa a ɛyɛ den a ɛbɔ fi apuei kɔ atɔe (jet streams) na ɛka no. Ahum akɛse kyinkyini wɔ saa nsensanee yi mu, na nea ɛso sen biara ne Great Red Spot, ahum kurukuruwa (anticyclone) a ne tɛtrɛtɛ boro Asase a ada so mfe 350 anaa nea ɛboro saa. Ne mu tɔnn no, metallic hydrogen no nsu-sen (currents) yɛ adwuma sɛ dynamo, na ɛma magnet tumi a ɛyɛ den sen okyinnsoromma biara de wɔ owia nsoromma kuw no mu ba. Saa tumi no twa magnetosphere kɛse pa ara, na ɛkyere radiation a ano yɛ den a ekum ade ahama (belts), a NASA Juno ahunmu-hyɛn no ayɛ ne mfonini fitaa ne okyinnsoromma no mframa a ne ntini kɔ fam tɔnn no nyinaa.

Jupiter wɔ ɔsram a wonim no bɛyɛ 95 anaa nea ɛboro saa ne nkaa (ring system) a ɛnhyerɛn kɛse. Galilean ɔsram akɛse anan a wohuu wɔn wɔ afe 1610 no yɛ wiase ankasa wɔ wɔn ankasa kwan so: Io a ogya-bepɔw (volcano) wɔ so, a ɛyɛ ade a asase nsakrae wɔ so pii sen biara wɔ owia nsoromma kuw no mu; Europa a nsukyenee akata so, a ɛde po a nkyene wom asie n'ase; Ganymede kɛse a ɔso sen Mercury na ɔwɔ n'ankasa magnet tumi; ne Callisto a amena (craters) pii wɔ so. Jupiter nyinaa-twe tumi (gravity) kɛse no hyehyɛ asteroid ahama (asteroid belt) no, kyere Trojan asteroid ahorow, na ɛdan anaa ɛtwe comet ahorow a ɛretwam. Ahunmu-hyɛn adwuma abien, ESA JUICE ne NASA Europa Clipper, rekɔ hɔ seesei sɛ wɔrekɔsua ne nsukyenee po ɔsram a ɛyɛ anigye no ho ade.
jupiter.adult:
NHYEHYƐE NE NEA WƆDE AYƐ NO — Jupiter ne mframa okyinnsoromma kɛse (gas giant) a ɛyɛ nhwɛso pa, a ne mfinimfini (equatorial) radius bɛyɛ kilomita 69,911 na ne duru (mass) ne Asase bɛyɛ 318 yɛ pɛ — ɛboro okyinnsoromma a aka nyinaa a ɛwɔ owia nsoromma kuw no mu a wɔaka abom. Ɛwom sɛ ne duru sõ saa de, nanso ne density a ɛyɛ nkyekyɛmu no sua, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ ade a wɔde mframa a ɛyɛ hare na ayɛ ɛkame ayɛ sɛ ne nyinaa, na ɛnyɛ ɔbo ne dade. Nea wɔde ayɛ ne fã kɛse no yɛ hydrogen bɛyɛ ɔha mu 90 ne helium ɔha mu 10 sɛ wɔkan atom dodow a, susudua a ɛne nea wɔde ayɛ Owia no hyia pɛpɛɛpɛ na ɛkyerɛ tete nneɛma a ɛwɔ owia nebula no mu a wɔn baanu nyinaa fii mu bae bɛyɛ mfe ɔpepepem 4.6 (4.6 billion) ni. Saa nsesoɔ yi ma Jupiter yɛ nsoromma bi a antumi anyɛ nsoromma, ɛwom mpo sɛ wammɛn duru a ɛho hia na ama hydrogen fusion asɔ wɔ ne mu no koraa. Mununkum a wohu no atifi no ase, asase den biara nni hɔ wɔ ɔkwan biara a yenim so. Hydrogen mframa (molecular hydrogen) no ara na ɛyɛ duru na ɛhyew bere a wɔkɔ fam, kosi sɛ, wɔ nhyɛso (pressure) a ɛyɛ bar ɔpepem pii ase no, ɛdan kɔ liquid metallic hydrogen nsensanee kɛse mu, tebea a hydrogen yɛ adwuma sɛ ade a anyinam-ahoɔden (electricity) fa mu. Mu nhyehyɛe nhwɛso (interior models) a ahunmu-hyɛn nsɛm boa no kyerɛ sɛ Jupiter nni ɔbo-ne-nsukyenee mfinimfini (core) a ɛyɛ den a n'ano da hɔ pefee, na mmom ɛwɔ mfinimfini a ɛyɛ mmerɛw anaa 'fuzzy' a nnɔɔso a emu yɛ duru no afã bi anan wɔ mu na wɔafrafra kɔ metallic hydrogen a atwa ho ahyia no mu nkakrankakra. Jupiter nso wɔ n'ankasa mu ahoɔden fibea: ɛma ahoɔden a ɛboro nea ɛnya fi owia hann mu no bɛyɛ mpɛn 1.6. Saa ɔhyew a ɛboro so yi yɛ tete de, a aka fi okyinnsoromma no nyinaa-twe tumi mu bubu (gravitational collapse) bere a ɛrebɔ no mu, na ɛkɔ so fi mu bere a Jupiter rebɔ mu nkakrankakra, na ɛma convection kɔ so wɔ ne mu tɔnn nyinaa. Wɔ afe 1995 no, Galileo adwuma no de wim-hwehwɛ afiri (atmospheric probe) too saa akyi nsensanee yi mu — ɛno nkutoo ne okyinnsoromma kɛse bi wim mframa a wɔahwehwɛ mu tẽẽ pɛn — na esusuw mframa, ɔhyew ne nea wɔde ayɛ no bere a ɛresiane kosi sɛ nhyɛso a ɛrekɔ soro no sɛee no.

---

WIM MFRAMA, MAGNET TUMI NE NE NKEKAMU — Jupiter kyinkyini pɛnkoro wɔ bɛyɛ nnɔnhwerew 9.9 pɛ mu, okyinnsoromma biara nkyinkyini a ɛyɛ ntɛm sen biara, na saa nkyinkyini a ɛyɛ ntɛm yi na edi ne wim mframa nneyɛe so. Nkyinkyini no hyehyɛ wim tebea no ma ɛyɛ mframa a ɛyɛ den a ɛbɔ kɔ apuei ne atɔe a edi so adi so (zonal jets), a ɛkyekyɛ ammonia mununkum a wohu no mu ma ɛyɛ nsensanee a ɛhyerɛn a wɔfrɛ no zones ne nea ɛyɛ tuntum a wɔfrɛ no belts. Wɔ saa nsensanee yi mu no, ahum ne mframa a ɛkyinkyini (vortices) a wontumi nkan wɔ hɔ, na nea agye din sen biara ne Great Red Spot, ahum kurukuruwa (anticyclone) kɛse a ne tɛtrɛtɛ boro Asase a abɔ mfeha abiɛsa ne fã anaa nea ɛboro saa. Mununkum no ase tɔnn no, liquid metallic hydrogen nsu-sen a ɛrekyinkyini no yɛ adwuma sɛ okyinnsoromma dynamo, na ɛma magnet tumi a ne dodow nyinaa (total moment) boro Asase de bɛyɛ mpɛn 20,000 ba. Saa tumi yi hono magnetosphere a ɛso araa sɛ, sɛ wohu fi Asase a, anka ɛbɛyɛ kɛse asen Owia, na ɛkyere particles a wɔwɔ ahoɔden kɛse a wɔwɔ electric charge ahama, a ɛyɛ radiation tebea a ekum ade ma ahunmu-hyɛn ne electronics nneɛma. NASA Juno adwuma a ɛretwa ho ahyia fi 2016 no de nyinaa-twe tumi nsusuwii a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ akyerɛ sɛ Jupiter mframa a ɛbɔ (jet streams) no kɔ fam kilomita mpempem, na ɛnyɛ ade a ɛwɔ ne so kɛkɛ, na asi mfinimfini a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔafrafra no ho dua. Juno nso ahwehwɛ ne ti ne n'ase (poles) ahum a ɛkyinkyini (cyclones) ne wim mframa no nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ afã abiɛsa (three-dimensional) mu, na ada okyinnsoromma a ɛyɛ nkekamu na nsensanee wɔ mu pii sen nea kan ahunmu-hyɛn a ɛtwaa mu no betumi kyerɛe adi. Magnetosphere nneyɛe koro no ara na ɛma aurora a ano yɛ den na ɛwɔ ahoɔden sen biara wɔ owia nsoromma kuw no mu ba, a ɛhyerɛn wɔ Jupiter ti ne n'ase a ɛboro Asase atifi ne anafo hann (northern and southern lights) no hyerɛn koraa. Magnetosphere no ankasa trɛw ara sɛ ne dua a ɛwɔ n'akyi no kɔ akyiri kilomita ɔpepem ɔhaha pii, a edu Saturn kwan (orbit) no ho pɛɛ, na ogya-bepɔw ɔsram Io de particles a wɔwɔ electric charge ma no bere nyinaa. Jupiter nkyinkyini a ɛyɛ ntɛm no nso ma okyinnsoromma no yɛ oblate a wohu no pefee — ɛyɛ tɛtrɛtɛ wɔ ne ti ne n'ase na ɛhono wɔ ne mfinimfini (equator) — nsakrae a ɛno ankasa hyehyɛ ne mframa nsensanee no nhyehyɛe.

---

ƆSRAM AHOROW NE NE DWUMADI — Jupiter di ɔsram kuw kɛse a ɔsram a wonim no boro 95 so, ne nkaa (ring) a mfutuma wom a ɛnhyerɛn kɛse. Galilean ɔsram akɛse anan a Galileo huu wɔn wɔ afe 1610 no ne okyinnsoromma ho nimdeɛ a wɔde toto ho (comparative planetology) nnyinaso, na wɔka mmeae a ɛtwetwe adwene sen biara wɔ owia nsoromma kuw no mu ho. Io ne ade a ogya-bepɔw yɛ adwuma wɔ so pii sen biara a wonim, a ne mu kɔ so nan bere nyinaa esiane ɔhyew a efi tidal (tidal heating) a ano yɛ den a Jupiter ne ɔsram a wɔbɛn no no de wɔn nyinaa-twe tumi kyinkyim no nti, na ɛma ogya-bepɔw ɔhaha pii a ɛrepae ne lava ɔtare ba. Europa, a nsukyenee ahoɔden a ɛyɛ foforo a apaapae akata so no, de nsu a nkyene wom po a ɛtrɛw wiase no nyinaa asie n'ase, a ebia nsu a ɛwɔ mu boro Asase po nyinaa de, na ɛno nti ayɛ astrobiology botae a edi kan. Ganymede, ɔsram a ɔso sen biara wɔ owia nsoromma kuw no mu na ɔso sen okyinnsoromma Mercury no, saa ara nso na ɔwɔ po wɔ ne mu, na ɔno nkutoo ne ɔsram a wonim sɛ ɔma n'ankasa magnet tumi ba. Callisto a amena wɔ so, Galilean ɔsram a ɔwɔ akyiri sen biara no, yɛ tete wiase a asase nsakrae nni so a ne so a wɔabobɔ no pii no de tete owia nsoromma kuw no ho kyerɛwtohɔ sie, na ebia ɔno nso de nkyene nsu nsensanee bi asie. Nea atwa okyinnsoromma no ho ahyia bɛn no yɛ mfutuma nkaa a ɛnhyerɛn kɛse, a Voyager 1 a ɛtwaa mu wɔ 1979 no na edii kan huu, na wosusuw sɛ micrometeoroid a ɛbɔ Jupiter ɔsram nketewa a ɛwɔ mu no na ɛma ɛyɛ foforo. Ne ɔsram ahorow no akyi no, Jupiter di dwuma titiriw wɔ owia nsoromma kuw no nyinaa nhyehyɛe mu. Ne nyinaa-twe tumi kɛse no hyehyɛ asteroid ahama (asteroid belt) no, yi ntam a ɛyɛ resonant mu nneɛma fi hɔ na ɛkanyan nneɛma nketewa akwan, bere a ɛkyere Trojan asteroid dodow pii a wɔne no fa kwan koro twa Owia ho hyia. Ɛyɛ comet ahorow nso adwuma, ɛtɔ mmere bi a ɛdan wɔn kɔ akwan foforo so na ɛtɔ mmere bi nso a ɛtwe wɔn ba, sɛnea ɛyɛe a agye din bere a ɛmenee Comet Shoemaker-Levy 9 wɔ 1994 no. Adwuma akɛse abien rehyia wɔ Jovian kuw no mu seesei sɛ wɔrekɔsua ne ɔsram a po wɔ mu no ho ade: NASA Europa Clipper, a ɛbɛtwam abɛn Europa mpɛn pii de asusuw sɛ ebia nkwa betumi atena hɔ, ne ESA JUICE, Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer, a awiei koraa no ɛbɛkɔ akɔtwa Ganymede ho ahyia.

saturn.kids: Saturn ne okyinnsoromma a ɔwɔ nkaa no, a nkaa mpempem a ɛhyerɛn a wɔde nsukyenee ne abo ayɛ atwa ne ho ahyia. Ne mu yɛ hare pa ara wɔ ne kɛseyɛ ho, enti sɛ wode to nsu a ɛwɔ adware-kyɛnsee kɛse bi mu a, ɛbɛtɛ nsu no so!
saturn.middle: Saturn yɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛtɔ so nsia, na ɛyɛ nea ɛso de kɛse to so mmienu; ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ 120,500 km. Ɛyɛ mframa-okyinnsoromma kɛse (gas giant) a wɔde hydrogen ne helium ayɛ, na ne nkaa a ɛyɛ nwonwa no na ama agye din — nsukyenee ne abo asinasin a wontumi nkan, efi nketenkete so kosi abotan a ɛso sɛ ofie, a ɛtrɛw kɔ akyirikyiri nanso ne mu piw bɛyɛ mita 10 pɛ. Saturn ne okyinnsoromma a ne mu yɛ hare sen biara (least dense); ne mu yɛ hare wɔ ne kɛseyɛ ho araa ma ɛbɛtɛ nsu so. Ɛkyinkyini ntɛm (da baako yɛ bɛyɛ nnɔnhwerew 10.7) nanso egye bɛyɛ Asase mfe 29 ansa na atwa Owia ho ahyia. Saturn wɔ asram (moons) a wonim bɛyɛ 146 — ɛboro okyinnsoromma biara de — a Titan kɛse ka ho, a ɔwɔ wim mframa a ɛyɛ den ne nsu atare a methane a ɛyɛ nsu ahyɛ mu, ne Enceladus ketewa, a ɔtow nsu fi po a ahintaw mu kɔ wim.
saturn.high:
Saturn yɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛtɔ so nsia fi Owia ho, na ɛyɛ wiase a ɛso de kɛse to so mmienu wɔ owia-nhyehyɛe (solar system) no mu; ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 120,536 — ɛbɛyɛ Asase tɛtrɛtɛ mpɛn du. Ɛyɛ mframa-okyinnsoromma kɛse (gas giant) a hydrogen ne helium na ɛwɔ mu dodow koraa, na enni asase a ɛyɛ den a wobetumi agyina so. Nea ɛyɛ nwonwa sen biara ne sɛ Saturn ne okyinnsoromma a ne mu yɛ hare sen biara (least dense): ne density a ɛtaa yɛ no sua sen nsu de, enti sɛ wubetumi anya po bi a ɛso a ɛbɛtumi akora no a, okyinnsoromma no nyinaa bɛtɛ nsu no so. Saa hareyɛ a ɛyɛ nwonwa yi fi ne mframa nneɛma a ɛtrɛw wɔ kwan kɛse pa ara mu.

Nea Saturn agye din wɔ ho pa ara ne ne nkaa nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ fɛ no, a ɛtrɛw fi okyinnsoromma no ho kɔ akyiri bɛyɛ kilomita 280,000, nanso ne mu piw a ɛtaa yɛ bɛyɛ mita 10 pɛ. Wɔde nsukyenee ne abo asinasin a wontumi nkan na ayɛ nkaa no, efi nketenkete so kosi abotan a ɛso sɛ ofie, na twe-tumi (gravity) ne asram nketewa a wɔfrɛ wɔn "shepherd moons" hyehyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ nkaa nketenkete mpempem a ɛda nsow. Okyinnsoromma no ankasa kyinkyini ntɛm pa ara, na ɛwie ɔkyinkyin baako wɔ bɛyɛ nnɔnhwerew 10.7 mu, na eyi ma ne mfimfini (equator) bɔ pue kɛse na ɛka omununkum a ɛyɛ sikakɔkɔɔ a ahoa a ɛyɛ ntentenso. Mframa-asu (jet stream) a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɛwɔ afa nsia — ahinanan-nsia (hexagon) a ɛtena hɔ daa — atwa n'atifi pole no ho ahyia. Ɛwom sɛ ɛkyinkyini ntɛm saa de, nanso Saturn gye bɛyɛ Asase mfe 29 ansa na atwa Owia a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no ho ahyia pɛnkoro.

Saturn wɔ asram a wɔasi so dua bɛyɛ 146, a ɛboro okyinnsoromma biara de. Nea ɛso sen biara, Titan, so sen okyinnsoromma Mercury, na ɔwɔ nitrogen wim mframa a ɛyɛ den ne nsu atare ne po a methane ne ethane a ɛyɛ nsu ahyɛ mu wɔ n'ani so — wim-tebea nhyehyɛe a ɛte sɛ Asase de a ɛyɛ nwonwa, a ɛnam chemistry foforo so. Enceladus ketewa a ɛyɛ nsukyenee no tow nsu-huhuw ne organic molecules a ɛyɛ nwonwa fi po a ahintaw wɔ n'ase no mu fa mpaapae a ɛbɛn n'anafo pole a wɔfrɛ no "tiger stripes" so, na eyi ma ɛyɛ mmeae a ɛma anidaso sen biara a wɔbɛhwehwɛ nkwa wɔ Asase akyi no mu biako. Nea yenim fa saa nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ nwonwa yi ho no mu dodow fi Cassini-Huygens adwumayɛ no mu, a ɛsuaa Saturn fi afe 2004 kosi 2017, na mpo ɛde probe bi sii Titan ani so.
saturn.adult:
NHYEHYƐE NE NNEƐMA A ƐWƆ MU — Saturn yɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛtɔ so nsia fi Owia ho, na ɛyɛ nea ɛso de kɛse to so mmienu wɔ owia-nhyehyɛe no mu; ne mfimfini (equatorial) radius bɛyɛ kilomita 58,232, na ne mu duru (mass) bɛyɛ Asase de mpɛn 95. Ɛwom sɛ ɛso saa de, nanso ɛyɛ hareyɛ a ɛboro so ho nhwɛso: Saturn yɛ mframa-okyinnsoromma kɛse a hydrogen bɛyɛ ɔha mu 96 (96 percent) ne helium bɛyɛ ɔha mu 3 (3 percent) na ɛwɔ mu, na ne mean density sua sen okyinnsoromma biara de — ɛyɛ bɛyɛ gram 0.69 wɔ cubic centimeter biara mu — a ɛsua sen nsu a ɛyɛ nsu (liquid water) density. Enti, sɛ yɛbɛka no saa a, Saturn bɛtɛ nsu so. Te sɛ Jupiter no, Saturn nni ani (surface) pɔtee; mmom, ne mframa-ntama no kɔ fam nkakrankakra a nhyɛ (pressure) ne hyew kɔ soro. Molecular hydrogen dan kɔ liquid metallic hydrogen a ɛyɛ nhyɛn a ɛkɔ fam — hydrogen a wɔahyɛ no so dennen ara kosi sɛ ɛma electricity fa mu te sɛ dade (metal) — a atwa core a ne mu yɛ duru a wɔde nneɛma a emu yɛ duru ayɛ no ho ahyia. Saa mu a ɛma electricity fa mu yi, a okyinnsoromma no kyinkyin ntɛm no kanyan no, na ɛma Saturn magnetic field a ɛyɛ den no ba. Ade a ɛyɛ nwonwa pa ara wɔ okyinnsoromma no ho ne ne mu ahoɔden sikasɛm (internal energy budget): Saturn tow ahoɔden a ɛbɛyɛ mpɛn 2.5 sen nea ɛnya fi owia hann mu. Wosusuw sɛ saa hyew a ɛboro so yi mu kɛse fi adeyɛ bi a wɔfrɛ no helium osu (helium rain) mu, a ɛne sɛ helium ne metallic hydrogen a atwa ho ahyia no nfra bio wɔ fam (immiscible), ɛdan nsu-nsensanee (droplets), na ɛmem kɔ mu. Bere a saa nsensanee no rehwe ase no, wogyaa twe-tumi ahoɔden (gravitational potential energy) sɛ hyew, na eyi boa ma yɛte okyinnsoromma no hyew ne helium a ɛsow kakra wɔ ne wim mframa a ɛwɔ soro no ase. Wɔanim Saturn fi tete sɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri sen biara a wobetumi de ani kwa ahu, na ne kyinkyin a ɛyɛ ntɛm ne ne density a ɛsua no nso ma ɛyɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛyɛ tɛtrɛtɛ (oblate) sen biara, a wohu pefee sɛ ne poles no ayɛ petee na ne mfimfini (equator) abɔ pue. Saa nneɛma yi nyinaa bom ma Saturn yɛ abɔde mu nhwehwɛmu beae (natural laboratory) a wɔde te sɛnea okyinnsoromma akɛse kora ahoɔden na wogyaa no wɔ mfe ɔpepepem pii mu no ase.

---

NKAA NE WIM MFRAMA — Saturn anuonyam titiriw ne ne nkaa nhyehyɛe, a ɛtrɛw na ɛyɛ nwonwa sen okyinnsoromma biara de. Nkaa no mu ɔha mu 99 (99 percent) boro so yɛ nsukyenee, na nea aka no yɛ abo ne mfutuma, na wɔn mu nneɛma (particles) no fi micrometer kɛseyɛ nketenkete so kosi abotan. Ɛwom sɛ wɔtrɛw kilomita mpem ɔha pii de, nanso nkaa atitiriw no mu piw a ɛtaa yɛ bɛyɛ mita 10 pɛ. Nsoromma ho animdefo (astronomers) de nkyerɛwde (letters) kyerɛ nkaa atitiriw no, efi D ne C nkaa a ɛwɔ mu no kɔ akyiri fa B ne A nkaa a ɛhyerɛn no so kosi E kaa a ɛyɛ pintinn a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no. Ntam akɛse (gaps) paapae nhyehyɛe no mu, na nea agye din sen biara ne Cassini Division a ɛpaapae A ne B nkaa no mu, na nhyehyɛe nketenkete no mu dodow no, orbital resonances ne "shepherd moons" nketewa a wɔn twe-tumi kyekyere nkaa ano na ɛtew ntam no mu na ɛyɛ. Nea ɛyɛ nwonwa ne sɛ ebia nkaa no nnii nkyɛ wɔ asase-nsɛm (geologically) mu — ebia mfe ɔpepem du kɔ ɔha pii pɛ — na ebetumi ayɛ ɔsram bi anaa comet bi a abubu no mporoporowa, a ɛne okyinnsoromma tete a atwa ho ahyia no yɛ nsonoe kɛse. Esiane sɛ nneɛma no mu biara di n'ankasa kwan (orbit) nti, nkaa nneɛma a ɛbɛn Saturn no kyinkyin ntɛm sen nea ɛwɔ akyiri no, sɛnea Kepler mmara kyerɛ, na Cassini huu nsensanee a ɛda nsow bere tiaa a wɔfrɛ no "spokes" a ɛretwa nkaa no so. Wim mframa no nso yɛ nea ɛkeka ne ho saa ara. Saturn kyinkyin wɔ bɛyɛ nnɔnhwerew 10.7 mu, na saa kyinkyin ntɛm yi, a hyew a efi mu ba soro no ka ho, ma omununkum ntentenso ne mframa akɛse (zonal winds) a ɛkɔ bɛyɛ kilomita 1,800 wɔ dɔnhwerew biara mu wɔ mfimfini (equator) no ho. Atifi pole no so na owia-nhyehyɛe no mu ade a ɛyɛ nwonwa ankasa biako wɔ: mframa-asu (jet stream) a ɛwɔ afa nsia a ɛtena hɔ daa a wɔfrɛ no hexagon, asorɔkye a egyina pintinn (standing wave) wɔ wim mframa no mu a enni ne sɛso pɔtee baabiara. Saturn ntwea (axis) akyea bɛyɛ degree 26.7, a ɛbɛn Asase ankasa de, enti okyinnsoromma no nya mmere (seasons) a ɛda nsow wɔ ne mfe 29.4 kwan (orbit) no mu. Saa akyea (obliquity) yi nso sesa twea a owia hann bɔ nkaa no no bere nyinaa, na ɛma wɔn hyerɛn a wohu ne mpo sɛnea wotumi hu wɔn fi Asase so no kɔ soro ba fam wɔ Saturn afe tenten no mu.

---

ASRAM NE NHWEHWƐMU — Saturn na ɔwɔ asram dodow sen biara wɔ owia-nhyehyɛe no mu, a satellites a wɔasi so dua boro 146, efi asinasin nketenkete a wɔn kwan nni nhyehyɛe so kosi wiase ahorow a wɔwɔ nyansahu mu mfaso ankasa. Nsukyenee asram akɛse te sɛ Mimas a amena pii wɔ so ne Rhea ne Dione a wɔn ani hyerɛn na amena wɔ so no akyi no, asram mmienu da nsow. Titan, a ɛyɛ ɔsram a ɛso de kɛse to so mmienu wɔ owia-nhyehyɛe no mu wɔ Jupiter ɔsram Ganymede akyi na ɛso sen okyinnsoromma Mercury, ne ɔsram koro pɛ a wonim sɛ ɔwɔ wim mframa a ɛyɛ den — nitrogen ntama a emu yɛ den a asase bi a nsu-kwan nhyehyɛe (hydrologic cycle) a edi mu ayɛ no da n'ase. Nanso wɔ Titan so de, nea ɛsen hɔ no nyɛ nsu na mmom hydrocarbons: methane ne ethane tɔ sɛ osu, paapae nsubɔnten akwan, boaboa ano yɛ po akɛse, na ɛyɛ anhwea-nkoko (dune fields) a ɛtrɛw, na eyi ma ebia ɛyɛ ani so tebea a ɛte sɛ Asase de sen biara a yenim, ɛwom sɛ ɛyɛ awɔw a ɛboro so de. NASA Dragonfly adwumayɛ no, rotorcraft a nuclear ahoɔden na ɛka no a wɔayɛ no sɛ ɛbɛhuruhuruw fi beae kɔ beae wɔ Titan ani so, na wɔahyehyɛ sɛ ɛbɛhwehwɛ saa chemistry foforo yi mu wɔ mfe du yi akyi. Enceladus, ɛwom sɛ ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 500 pɛ de, nanso ɛyɛ nea ɛtwe adwene saa ara. Efi nsu po a ɛwɔ n'ase no mu, saa nsukyenee ɔsram yi tow nsu-huhuw, nkyene (salts), ne organic molecules a ɛkɔ soro tenteenten fa mpaapae a ɛbɛn n'anafo pole a wɔfrɛ no tiger stripes no so. Cassini wimhyɛn no faa saa nsu-huhuw no mu tẽẽ, na ɛfaa po no mu nneɛma hwɛe bere a ɛretu no, na ɛmaa Enceladus bɛyɛɛ mmeae atitiriw a wɔbɛhwehwɛ nkwa wɔ Asase akyi no mu biako. Nnɛ-yi ntease yi nyinaa fa ara fi Cassini-Huygens adwumayɛ no mu, amanaman ntam nkabom adwuma a ɛtwaa Saturn ho hyiae fi afe 2004 kosi 2017. Cassini yɛɛ nkaa, wim mframa, ne asram no ho mfonini wɔ ɔkwan a wɔnyɛɛ bi da so, bere a Huygens probe no sianee faa Titan kusuu no mu wɔ afe 2005 bɛyɛɛ wimhyɛn a edi kan koraa a esii ade bi a ɛwɔ owia-nhyehyɛe no akyi fa (outer solar system) so. Bere a ne pɛtro (fuel) sae no, wɔhyɛɛ da de Cassini bɔɔ Saturn mu na ama asram a ebia nkwa betumi atena so no anya ahobammɔ, na eyi de adwumayɛ a ɛda so yɛ Saturn nhyehyɛe nhwehwɛmu titiriw ne po-wiase nyansahu (ocean-world science) fapem no baa awiei.

uranus.kids: Uranus yɛ okyinnsoromma kɛseɛ a nsukyenee wom (ice giant) a ne ho yɛ bruu-ahabammono fitaa, na ɛdane ne ho wɔ ne nkyɛn mu te sɛ bɔɔl a ɛrepere atwa Owia ho ahyia! Ɛhɔ yɛ awɔ paa a ɛyɛ okyinnsoromma ahodoɔ nyinaa mu baako a awɔ wom sene biara.
uranus.middle: Uranus yɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛtɔ so nson, okyinnsoromma kɛseɛ a nsukyenee wom (ice giant) a ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ 51,000 km — ɛtrɛ sene Asase mprɛnan.
