Ɛte sɛ bruu-ahabammono ɛfiri sɛ methane a ɛwɔ ne mframa mu no twe hann kɔkɔɔ. Uranus yɛ soronko: abutu wɔ ne nkyɛn mu, na ne dane dua (axis) akyea bɛyɛ 98°, enti sɛ yɛbɛka a, ɛpere twa Owia ho hyia. Yei ma ɛnya mmerɛ a ɛyɛ den paa — ne pole biara nya owia hann a ɛnnyae bɛyɛ mfeɛ 42 na afei esum mfeɛ 42 di akyire wɔ ne mfeɛ 84 a ɛde twa Owia ho hyia no mu. Ɛyɛ okyinnsoromma a awɔ wom sene biara no mu baako, na ne mununkum atifi awɔ bɛn −220 °C. Uranus wɔ nkaa (rings) a ɛnhyerɛn yie ne ɔsrane 28 a yɛnim a wɔde Shakespeare ne Alexander Pope nhoma mu nnipa din ato wɔn. Wiemhyɛn baako pɛ, Voyager 2, na akɔsra hɔ pɛn, ɛtwaa ho wɔ afe 1986 mu.
uranus.high:
Uranus yɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛtɔ so nson firi Owia hɔ, na ɛyɛ 'ice giants' (okyinnsoromma akɛseɛ a nsukyenee wom) mmienu no mu deɛ ɛdi kan; ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ kilomita 50,724 — ɛtrɛ sene Asase bɛyɛ mprɛnan — nanso ne mu duru yɛ Asase mu duru mpɛn 14.5 pɛ, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛsene gas giants no kɛseɛ mu nanso ne mu nyɛ duru koraa sɛ wɔn. Wɔ mframa a ɛwɔ akyire a awɔ wom a ɛyɛ hydrogen, helium ne methane no ase no, 'nsukyenee' — nsuo, methane ne ammonia — a ayɛ nsuo a ɛyɛ hye a emu dɔ (mantle) wɔ hɔ a atwa ɔbo mfimfini kumaa bi ho ahyia. Methane a ɛwɔ mframa no soro no twe hann kɔkɔɔ na ɛpete hann bruu, na ɛno na ɛma Uranus hwɛ sɛ bruu-ahabammono (cyan) a ɛyɛ dinn. Deɛ ɛyɛ nwanwa ne sɛ, okyinnsoromma no mma ɔhyew a ɛboro deɛ ɛnya firi Owia hɔ no mpo; ne mu ɔhyew a ɛfiri mu ba no sua paa wɔ ɔkwan a yɛnte aseɛ so, ahintasɛm a ebia ɛne ɔpempem a ɛbɔɔ okyinnsoromma no maa ɛbutuiɛ bere bi no wɔ abusuabɔ.

Uranus nneɛma a agye din sene biara ne ne dane dua (axis) a akyea kɛseɛ bɛyɛ 98 degrees, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ okyinnsoromma no abutu wɔ ne nkyɛn mu na ɛpere wɔ ne mfeɛ 84 kwan a ɛde twa Owia ho hyia no so. Wiem nhwehwɛmufoɔ gye di sɛ saa gyinaberɛ yi firi ɔpempem kɛseɛ baako anaa bebree a ɛsisii wɔ wiem nsoromma kuo no abakɔsɛm mfitiaseɛ. Nkyea no de mmerɛ a ɛyɛ den sene baabiara ba: ne pole biara nya adekyeeɛ hann a ɛnnyae bɛyɛ mfeɛ 42 na afei anadwo a ɛmpa mfeɛ 42 di akyire. Uranus nso wɔ magnet tumi (magnetic field) a ɛyɛ nwanwa, a akyea afiri ne dane dua ho akɔ akyiri na ɛnni okyinnsoromma no mfimfini pɛɛ, a ɛma ɛnya magnetosphere a ɛnyɛ pɛ na ɛpere. Ɛyɛ okyinnsoromma mframa a awɔ wom sene biara wɔ wiem nsoromma kuo no mu, na ne mununkum atifi ɔhyew kɔ fam kɔsi bɛyɛ −224 °C.

Deɛ atwa okyinnsoromma no ho ahyia ne nkaa 13 a ɛyɛ teateaa na ɛyɛ tuntum ne ɔsrane 28 a yɛnim, a wɔde William Shakespeare ne Alexander Pope nnwuma mu nnipa din nyinaa ato wɔn. Deɛ ɛsoso enum no — Miranda, Ariel, Umbriel, Titania ne Oberon — kyerɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ asase ho nsakraeɛ (geologic activity) sii hɔ bere bi, na Miranda titire da abotan atentene a ɛyɛ hu ne asase a ɛyɛ basabasa adi. Wiemhyɛn baako pɛ, Voyager 2, na akɔsra Uranus pɛn, wɔ ɔtwa a ɛnkyɛreɛ wɔ January 1986 mu, na wiemhyɛn biara a wɔayi asi hɔ ankasa nkɔtwaa ho ahyia (orbit) da. Esiane sɛ nneɛma pii a ɛfa ne mu, ne magnet tumi a akyea, ne ne asrane a ebia ɛpo wɔ wɔn mu ho da so ara yɛ deɛ yɛnnim enti, U.S. Planetary Science Decadal Survey ato Uranus Orbiter and Probe sɛ ne flagship adwuma a ɛho hia sene biara.
uranus.adult:
NHYEHYƐEƐ NE NNEƐMA A ƐWƆ MU — Uranus yɛ 'ice giant' (okyinnsoromma kɛseɛ a nsukyenee wom) nhwɛsoɔ pa ara, wiase kuo a ɛda nsow firi abotan okyinnsoromma (terrestrials) ne gas giants Jupiter ne Saturn a hydrogen di wɔn so no nyinaa ho. Ne radius yɛ kilomita 25,362 na ne mu duru bɛyɛ Asase 14.5, na ɛno enti ɛyɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ tɛtrɛtɛ mu nanso ɛtɔ so nan pɛ wɔ mu duru mu, nkabom a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ne mu duru dodoɔ (bulk density) sua sɛ yɛde toto nkaeɛ no ho a. Ne ho a yɛhunu no yɛ mframa a awɔ wom a ɛyɛ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛyɛ molecular hydrogen ne helium a methane kakra bi — bɛyɛ ɔha mu kakra — fra mu, nanso saa gas ntoma yi yɛ tiaa sɛ yɛde toto deɛ ɛwɔ aseɛ no ho a. Aseɛ hɔ no, mantle a ɛtrɛ, ɛyɛ hye na electric tumi fa mu, a ɛyɛ 'nsukyenee' a wɔfrɛ no saa — nsuo, methane ne ammonia — wɔ hɔ; ɛnyɛ deɛ akyene ayɛ den na mmom ɛte sɛ nsuo a emu yɛ duru, ɛyɛ nkyenee-nsuo, na mia kɛseɛ (high pressure) wɔ so. Wɔgye di sɛ saa mantle yi, na ɛnyɛ metallic-hydrogen ntoatoasoɔ bi, na ɛma okyinnsoromma no magnet tumi a ɛyɛ nwanwa no ba, na atwa ɔbo-ne-dadeɛ mfimfini kumaa a ɛnsene Asase ho ahyia. Methane a ɛwɔ mframa no soro no na ɛma okyinnsoromma no ahosuo a ɛyɛ dinn no: ɛtwe owia hann kɔkɔɔ a ne mframa ware no na ɛpete bruu-ahabammono a ne mframa tia no san kɔ wiem, na ɛma cyan a ɛyɛ fitaa a Voyager 2 kyerɛɛ wɔ 1986 no ba, ɛwom sɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛdii akyire da mframa a ɛkeka ne ho, a ɛwɔ ntoma (bands) na ahum tumi ba mu bebree sene mfoni a ɛdi kan a ɛnyɛ nwanwa no kyerɛeɛ adi. Ebia Uranus mu ahintasɛm a ɛkyɛ sene biara ne ne ɔhyew ho akontabuo. Ɛnte sɛ Neptune, ne nua a ɔte sɛ ne ho mfoni, a ɔma ahoɔden a ɛboro deɛ ɔnya firi Owia hɔ no mpɛn mmienu ne akyi, Uranus mma ne mu ɔhyew a ɛboro so biara koraa; ne ɔhyew a wɔsusuu no sua wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nwanwa a yɛntumi nkyerɛ mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔde aba ne sɛ ebia nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu no ntoatoasoɔ siw convection kwan na ɛkata mfitiaseɛ ɔhyew no wɔ mu akyirikyiri, anaa sɛ ebia ɔpempem kɛseɛ tete bi too okyinnsoromma no mfitiaseɛ ɔhyew no bebree guiɛ. Sɛ yɛbɛhunu deɛ enti a ice giant baako yɛ awɔ bere a ne nua yɛ hye no da so ara yɛ asɛm titire ma okyinnsoromma ho nyansapɛ, na mmuaeɛ no ka sɛdeɛ ne baabi a ice giants no dii kan baeɛ wɔ wiem nsoromma kuo no mfitiaseɛ mununkum (solar nebula) mu no ho tẽẽ.

---

NKYEA, MMERƐ NE MAGNET TUMI — Okyinnsoromma su biara nni hɔ a ɛkyerɛ Uranus ho asɛm kɛseɛ sene ne dane dua a akyea kɛseɛ no. Ne obliquity a ɛbɛyɛ 97.8 degrees no kyerɛ sɛ ne dane dua (rotation axis) da ne kwan a ɛde twa Owia ho hyia no plane mu pɛɛ, enti okyinnsoromma no nnane ne ho sɛ nkaeɛ no a ɛgyina kirikiri na mmom ɛpere twa Owia ho hyia wɔ ne nkyɛn mu. Nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛdi anim ne sɛ ɛfiri ɔsɛeɛ bi: wɔgye di sɛ ɔpempem kɛseɛ baako anaa bebree a nneɛma a ɛte sɛ Asase anaa ɛsene saa boroo no wɔ okyinnsoromma nyɛ no nnaberɛ a ɛtwa toɔ a na ɛyɛ basabasa no mu na ɛbɔɔ Uranus a na ɔda so ara yɛ ketewa no buu no, na saa ɔpempem no nso bɛtumi aboa ama yɛate ne mu ɔhyew a ɛsua wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ nwanwa no ase. Saa gyinaberɛ a ɛda ne nkyɛn mu yi de mmerɛ a ɛyɛ den sene biara wɔ wiem nsoromma kuo no mu ba. Wɔ mfeɛ 84 a ɛde twa Owia ho hyia no mu no, ne pole biara nya owia hann a ɛnnyae bɛyɛ mfeɛ 42, na afei ɛkɔ esum a ɛmpa mu mfeɛ a ɛne no yɛ pɛ, bere a equator mpɔtam nya adekyeeɛ-anadwo a ɛdane ntɛm wɔ equinoxes no ho nko ara. Sɛdeɛ mframa no yɛ ne ho wɔ saa owia hann nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ nwanwa yi mu no, yɛnte aseɛ yie, na Voyager 2 ɔtwa baako pɛ no kyerɛɛ ne fa bi pɛ, ɛwom sɛ asase so ne Hubble nhwehwɛmu wɔ mfeɛ du du a atwam no mu afiri aseɛ rehyɛ ɛkwan no ma, na ada mmerɛ-mmerɛ hyerɛn, methane-nsukyenee mununkum a ɛda nsow, ne ahum akɛseɛ a ɛba bere ne bere adi bere a owia hann resan aba mmeammea a esum adi hɔ akyɛ no nkakrankakra. Deɛ ɛyɛ nwanwa saa ara ne okyinnsoromma no magnet tumi (magnetic field). Sɛ anka ɛne ne dane dua no bɛkɔ ɛkwan korɔ so sɛdeɛ Asase deɛ no teɛ no, Uranus deɛ akyea bɛyɛ 59 degrees na afiri okyinnsoromma no geometric mfimfini ho akɔ akyiri kɛseɛ, enti magnet tumi no ahoɔden sesa kɛseɛ firi ɛfa baako kɔ ɛfa foforɔ. Deɛ ɛfiri mu ba ne magnetosphere a ɛnyɛ pɛ na ɛnsisi hɔ pɛ a ɛpere basabasa bere a okyinnsoromma no dane ne ho, na ɛne owia mframa (solar wind) ka bom na ɛtete mu wɔ akwan a ɛnni nhwɛsoɔ a ɛda adi wɔ baabi foforɔ. Deɛ ɛka saa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nwanwa yi ho ne sɛ, Uranus wɔ mframa a awɔ wom sene okyinnsoromma biara wɔ wiem nsoromma kuo no mu: ne mununkum atifi ɔhyew kɔ fam kɔsi bɛyɛ 49 kelvin, bɛyɛ −224 degrees Celsius, a awɔ wom sene Neptune a ɛwɔ akyiri sene no mpo, nokorɛ a ɛne ne mu ɔhyew a ɛyɛ mmerɛ no wɔ abusuabɔ bio.

---

NKAA, ASRANE NE NHWEHWƐMU — Nkaa 13 a yɛnim atwa Uranus ho ahyia, a wɔhunuu wɔ 1977 bere a ɛsii nsoromma bi a ɛwɔ akyire no hann kwan bere tiaa bi. Ɛnte sɛ Saturn nkaa a ɛtrɛ, ɛhyerɛn na ɛyɛ nsukyenee no, Uranus nkaa no yɛ teateaa, ɛyɛ tuntum, na nneɛma a ɛwɔ mu no soso na ɛyɛ tuntum sɛ wisie, a asrane nketewa a ɛbɛn hɔ no adetwe (gravity) hwɛ wɔn so ma wɔyɛ nkaa teateaa. Okyinnsoromma no wɔ ɔsrane 28 a yɛnim, a wɔamfa tete anansesɛm mu nnipa din anto wɔn na mmom wɔde William Shakespeare agorɔ nhoma ne Alexander Pope anwensɛm mu nnipa din na ato wɔn. Asrane akɛseɛ enum no — Titania, Oberon, Umbriel, Ariel ne Miranda — yɛ nsukyenee ne abotan wiase a ɛkora asase ho nsakraeɛ a ɛsii kane no abakɔsɛm so. Titania ne Oberon na ɛsoso sene biara; Ariel kyerɛ asase a ɛyɛ foforɔ a ne ho asesa (resurfaced) adi; na Miranda ketewa no yɛ deɛ ɛyɛ nwanwa sene biara, ne ho yɛ abotan atentene, mpampam a ɛwɔ nkwanta ne asase basabasa a adi afra a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ne abakɔsɛm yɛ basabasa anaa wɔsɛee no mpɛn bebree. Seesei wɔbu asrane yi mu bebree sɛ ebia wɔyɛ wiase a ɛpo wɔ mu (candidate ocean worlds), a ebia nsuo a ɛyɛ nsuo pɛɛ wɔ wɔn nsukyenee bona no ase, na ɛno ma Uranus kuo no yɛ baabi a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhwehwɛ mmeammea a nkwa bɛtumi atena wɔ Owia habitable zone a yɛnim no akyiri koraa. Ɛwom sɛ ɛwɔ nneɛma bebree saa deɛ, nanso Uranus da so ara yɛ okyinnsoromma kɛseɛ a wɔnhwehwɛɛ ne mu sene biara. Wiemhyɛn baako pɛ, Voyager 2, na akɔ hɔ pɛn, ɛtwaa ho wɔ January 1986 wɔ ne akwantuo kɛseɛ a ɛfaa wiem nsoromma kuo no akyiri fa no mu, na ɛde kuo no nyinaa ho nsɛm a ɛbɛn a adasamma wɔ nko ara baeɛ. Wiemhyɛn biara nkɔtwaa ho ahyia (orbit) da, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ yɛn nimdeɛ a ɛfa okyinnsoromma no mu nhyehyɛeɛ, ne mframa nsakraeɛ, ne nkaa nneyɛeɛ ne ne asrane ho no gyina ɔtwa a adi mfeɛ du du a telescope nhwehwɛmu aka ho no so kɛseɛ. Esiane sɛ wɔhunu saa akwan yi enti, U.S. Planetary Science Decadal Survey ato Uranus Orbiter and Probe sɛ ne flagship adwuma a ɛho hia sene biara ma berɛ a ɛreba no. Adwuma a ɛte saa bɛsoma mframa mu nhwehwɛmu afidie (atmospheric entry probe) na ɛde mfeɛ bebree atwa kuo no ho ahyia, de abotaeɛ sɛ ɛbɛhunu okyinnsoromma no magnet tumi a ɛyɛ nwanwa no mu, asusu nneɛma a ɛwɔ ne mu ankasa ne ne ɔhyew a ɛfiri mu ba, na ahwɛ sɛ ne asrane akɛseɛ no bɛtumi akura ɛpo a nkwa bɛtumi atena mu wɔ wɔn ase anaa.

neptune.kids: Neptune ne okyinnsoromma a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri paa, nsukyenee okyinnsoromma kɛse a ɛyɛ bruu tuntum a ɛwɔ mframa a ɛtu ntɛm sen biara wɔ owia nhyehyɛe no mu — ahum a ɛtu ntɛm sen wimhyɛn! Ɛwɔ akyirikyiri araa ma ɛgye mfe 165 ansa na ɛtwa Owia no ho hyia.
neptune.middle: Neptune ne okyinnsoromma a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe na ɛwɔ akyirikyiri sen biara, nsukyenee okyinnsoromma kɛse a ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ 49,000 km na ɛyɛ bruu tuntum a ɛhyerɛn esiane methane a ɛwɔ ne wiem mframa mu nti. Ɛno ne okyinnsoromma a mframa tu wɔ so sen biara, a ahum a ɛtu ntɛm sen nnyigyeɛ bobɔm kɔsi bɛyɛ 2,000 km/h. Neptune wɔ akyirikyiri fi Owia no ho — bɛyɛ 4.5 billion km — araa ma ɛgye Asase mfe 165 ansa na ɛtwa ho hyia pɛnkoro, na ne mununkum atifi yɛ nwini paa, bɛyɛ −220 °C. Nea ɛyɛ nwonwa ne sɛ, wohuu Neptune wɔ afe 1846 mu denam akontaabu so: nsoromma ho nimdefo hyɛɛ nkɔm faa baabi a ɛwɔ ho fii ɔkwan a ne ɔtwetwe tumi twee Uranus so no mu, afei wɔde ahwehwɛ a wɔde hwɛ nsoromma (teleskop) kyerɛɛ hɔ na wohuu no. Ɛwɔ nkaa a ɛnhyerɛn pii ne asram 16 a yenim, na nea ɛso sen biara ne Triton, a ɛtwa ho hyia kɔ akyi na ɛwɔ nitrogen a ɛpue fi fam sɛ geysers — nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔkyeree no fii Kuiper Belt a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri no mu.
neptune.high:
Neptune ne okyinnsoromma a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe na ɛwɔ Owia no akyi paa, nsukyenee okyinnsoromma kɛse a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri a ɛtwa Owia ho hyia wɔ bɛyɛ astronomical units 30. Ne tɛtrɛtɛ (diameter) yɛ kilomita 49,244, enti ɛno ne okyinnsoromma akɛse no mu ketewa paa, nanso ɛno na emu yɛ duru sen biara, ɛde Asase mu duru bɛyɛ 17.1 ahyɛ ne honam ketewa no mu. Wiem mframa a ɛyɛ nwini a ɛwɔ akyire a ɛyɛ hydrogen, helium ne methane no ase no, ɛwɔ mantle a ɛyɛ hyew na ɛyɛ atɔtɔ a ɛyɛ nsuo, methane ne ammonia a atwa ɔbo mfimfini (core) ho ahyia. Methane a ɛwɔ wiem mframa no soro no twe owia hann kɔkɔɔ no gu, na ɛno ma Neptune nya ne bruu tuntum a ɛyɛ fɛ no, bruu a ɛyɛ den sen Uranus de mpo.

Ɛwom sɛ Neptune nnya owia hann kakra mpo wɔ n'akyirikyiri kɛse no mu de, nanso ɛyɛ wiase a ɛyɛ adwuma paa wɔ owia nhyehyɛe no mu. Ɛwɔ mframa a ɛtu ntɛm sen biara a wɔasusu wɔ okyinnsoromma biara so, a ɛteateam kɔsi bɛyɛ kilomita 2,100 dɔnhwerew biara, na ɛwɔ ahum tuntum akɛse a ɛba na ɛyera wɔ mfe pii mu. Voyager 2 twaa saa ahum no mu biako mfoni, Great Dark Spot no, bere a ɛretwa mu wɔ afe 1989 mu no. Saa ahoɔden a ɛyɛ nwonwa yi fi emu: Neptune ma ɔhyew a ɛboro nea ɛgye fi Owia no mu so bɛyɛ mpɛn 2.6, na saa emu fononoo no na ɛma ne wim tebea a ɛyɛ basabasa no. Ne magnet tumi beaeɛ no akyea bɛyɛ digrii 47 afi ne kyinii nnyinasoɔ no ho na ɛmfi okyinnsoromma no mfimfini.

Neptune wɔ beae soronko wɔ nyansahu abakɔsɛm mu sɛ okyinnsoromma a wɔnam akontaabu kronkron so huu no. Wɔ 1840 mfe no mu, nsoromma ho nimdefo hui sɛ Uranus renkɔ sɛnea wɔhwɛ kwan, na Urbain Le Verrier ne John Couch Adams buu akontaa hwehwɛɛ baabi a ɛsɛ sɛ okyinnsoromma a wonhu no wɔ. Wɔ afe 1846 mu, Johann Galle de teleskop kyerɛɛ hɔ na ohuu Neptune bɛn beae a wɔhyɛɛ ho nkɔm no. Ne kwan a ɛtwa ho hyia no sõ araa ma Neptune afe biako kyɛ Asase mfe 164 — atwa Owia no ho ahyia pɛnkoro pɛ efi bere a wohuu no. Neptune wɔ nkaa anum a ɛnhyerɛn ne asram 16 a yenim. Nea ɛso sen biara, Triton, twa ho hyia kɔ akyi, nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia na ɛyɛ Kuiper Belt ade a Neptune ɔtwetwe tumi kyeree no, na ne soro a ɛyɛ nwini paa no pae ma nitrogen pue fi mu sɛ geysers. Ewiem hyɛn biako pɛ, Voyager 2, na akɔsra hɔ pɛn, na ɛno ma Neptune ho adwuma soronko bi yɛ botae a ɛtwetwe adwene ma daakye.
neptune.adult:
NE NHYEHYƐE NE NEA ƐWƆ MU — Neptune ne okyinnsoromma kɛse a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe na ɛwɔ akyi paa, nsukyenee okyinnsoromma kɛse a ɛtwa Owia no ho hyia wɔ bɛyɛ astronomical units 30, bɛyɛ kilomita 4.5 billion afi hann ne ɔhyew a ɛwɔ nhyehyɛe no mu fa no. Ne equator radius yɛ kilomita 24,622 — tɛtrɛtɛ (diameter) a ɛyɛ kilomita 49,244 — enti ɛyɛ ketewa kakra sen ne nua a ɔne no sɛ, Uranus, nanso emu yɛ duru sen no kɛse, na ɛwɔ Asase mu duru bɛyɛ 17.1. Saa nneɛma mmienu yi ma Neptune yɛ okyinnsoromma akɛse anan no mu nea emu yɛ duru sen biara, soronko a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛwɔ nneɛma a emu yɛ duru pii sen hydrogen ne helium a emu yɛ hare a ɛdi Jupiter ne Saturn so no. Asɛmfua "nsukyenee okyinnsoromma kɛse" no daadaa nipa kakra, efisɛ "nsukyenee" no nyɛ nneɛma a akyen ayɛ den, na mmom ɛyɛ nsuo a ɛyɛ hyew, emu yɛ duru, na anyinam ahoɔden tumi fa mu. Mframa a ɛwɔ akyire a ɛyɛ molecular hydrogen, helium ne methane no ase no, ɛwɔ mantle a emu dɔ a ɛyɛ nsuo, methane ne ammonia titiriw a wɔamia no akɔ ɔhyew ne nhyɛso a ɛboro so mu, a atwa ɔbo mfimfini (core) a ɛyɛ dade ne silicate a ne kɛse bɛyɛ sɛ Asase ho ahyia. Asase a ɛyɛ den a wobɛgyina so biara nni hɔ; nsakrae a efi wiem mframa kɔ nsuo a ɛwɔ emu no kɔ so nkakrankakra, na ɛkɔ fam ara bere a nhyɛso no reyɛ kɛse no. Saa emu yi ne ade titiriw a ɛma Neptune ne Uranus yɛ soronko fi mframa okyinnsoromma akɛse no ho: wɔn mu duru no fã kɛse no wɔ saa atɔtɔ a ɛyɛ hyew boro so a ɛyɛ nwonwa yi mu na ɛnyɛ hydrogen-helium wiem mframa kɛse bi mu. Nanso, nea ɛma Neptune yɛ soronko fi Uranus ho sen biara ne ne mu ɔhyew fibea a ɛwɔ tumi no. Neptune ma ahoɔden a ɛboro nea ɛnya fi Owia a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri a ne hann sua no mu so bɛyɛ mpɛn 2.6, na nea ɛboro so no yi emu a ɛda so redwo a ɛreyi mfitiase ɔhyew no adi. Saa emu afiri yi ho hia paa sɛ yɛbɛte okyinnsoromma no nyinaa ase, efisɛ ɛno na ɛma ahoɔden a ɛma Neptune wiem mframa no kyinkyin denneennen a ɛyɛ nwonwa no. Baabi a owia hann a ɛyɛ mmerɛw nko ara rentumi nkyerɛ adwuma a wohu no mu da no, ɔhyew a epue fi emu no ma convection ahoɔden, na ɛma Neptune yɛ wiase a ne wim tebea nya ahoɔden fi emu kɔ akyire kɛse sen sɛ ebefi nsoromma a ɛtwa ho hyia wɔ akyirikyiri saa no mu.

---

WIEM MFRAMA NE NE NKEKAHO — Ɛwom sɛ Neptune nnya owia hann a ɛboro nea edu Asase so no mu apem mu baako mpo de, nanso ɛyɛ wiase a ɛyɛ adwuma kɛse paa wɔ owia nhyehyɛe no mu. Ne wiem mframa no kura mframa a ɛtu ntɛm sen biara a wɔasusu wɔ okyinnsoromma biara so, a equator mframa ahoɔden no du bɛyɛ kilomita 2,100 dɔnhwerew biara — mframa a ɛtu ntɛm sen nnyigyeɛ a, nea ɛyɛ nwonwa ne sɛ, ɛtu kɔ ɔkwan a ɛne okyinnsoromma no kyinii no bɔ abira. Saa mframa yi hyehyɛ mununkum a wohu no ma ɛyɛ nhoma nhoma (bands) na ɛwo ahum akɛse a ɛba bere tiaa bi. Nea agye din sen biara wɔ eyinom mu ne Great Dark Spot no, ahum a ɛkyinkyin a ne kɛse te sɛ Asase a Voyager 2 twaa ne mfoni bere a ɛrehyia no wɔ afe 1989 mu no; bere a Hubble Space Telescope hwɛɛ hɔ mfe kakra akyi no, na saa ahum no ayera, bere a nsɛmsɛm tuntum foforo apue wɔ mmeae afoforo. Saa nneyɛe yi da wiem mframa a emu nneɛma akɛse tumi ba na ɛyera wɔ mfe kakraa bi pɛ mu adi, nea ɛne Jupiter Great Red Spot a ɛatra hɔ mfeha pii no bɔ abira koraa. Neptune bruu tuntum a ɛhyerɛn no fi wiem mframa mu nnuru nsakrae (chemistry). Methane mframa twe owia hann a ne tenten boro so a ɛyɛ kɔkɔɔ no gu na ɛbɔ bruu a ne tenten sua no san kɔ ewiem; saa kwan koro yi ara na ɛma Uranus nya ne kɔla, nanso Neptune yɛ bruu sen no pefee, nea ɛkyerɛ sɛ ade foforo bi wɔ ne wiem mframa mu a wonnya nhuu no a ɛma ne kɔla no mu yɛ den. Mununkum akɛse no atifi no, methane-nsukyenee mununkum (cirrus) a ɛwɔ soro paa no sunsum da adi wɔ Voyager mfoni mu, bere a mununkum atifi awɔw no kɔ fam kodu bɛyɛ digrii Celsius minus 220, a ɛka mmeae a ɛyɛ nwini sen biara wɔ owia nhyehyɛe no nyinaa mu ho. Okyinnsoromma no magnet tumi beaeɛ no yɛ nwonwa te sɛ ne wim tebea. Te sɛ Uranus de no, Neptune magnet tumi beaeɛ no akyea kɛse — akyea bɛyɛ digrii 47 afi ne kyinii nnyinasoɔ no ho — na ɛmfi okyinnsoromma no mfimfini koraa. Dynamo a ɛwɔ dade mfimfini ketewa bi mu nko ara ntumi mma saa nhyehyɛe yi; mmom ɛkyerɛ dynamo a ɛreyɛ adwuma wɔ nsukyenee mantle a anyinam ahoɔden fa mu no bɔnhoma a ɛyɛ tratraa kakra a ɛrekyinkyin mu. Mframa a ano yɛ den no, ahum a ɛntra hɔ nkyɛ no, ne magnet tumi beaeɛ a akyea no nyinaa bom ma Neptune yɛ abɔde mu adesua dan ma nsukyenee okyinnsoromma akɛse mu ne wɔn wiem mframa ho physics.

---

NE HU, N'ASRAM NE NE HO NHWEHWƐMU — Neptune gyina hɔ sɛ nkonimdi akɛse a ɛwɔ nsoromma ho nyansahu a wɔde adwene yɛ no mu biako, okyinnsoromma a edi kan a wɔnam akontaabu nkɔmhyɛ so huu no na ɛnyɛ asiane so nhwehwɛmu. Mfe du du a edii wɔn hu Uranus akyi no, nsoromma ho nimdefo hui sɛ ne kwan a ɛtwa ho hyia no man fii akontaabu no ho kakra, te sɛ nea ade bi a wonhu no a ɛwɔ akyi ɔtwetwe tumi retwe no. Urbain Le Verrier wɔ France ne John Couch Adams wɔ England de saa nsakrae yi buu akontaa wɔ wɔn ankasa kwan so hwehwɛɛ baabi a ɛsɛ sɛ saa okyinnsoromma no wɔ. Wɔ afe 1846 mu, Johann Galle a ɔwɔ Berlin Observatory no de Le Verrier nkyerɛkyerɛmu no dii dwuma huu Neptune wɔ digrii biako mu fi beae a wɔhyɛɛ ho nkɔm no — Newton ɔtwetwe tumi nkyerɛkyerɛ no ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛyɛ nwonwa. Esiane sɛ okyinnsoromma no wɔ akyirikyiri fi Owia no ho nti, bere a ɛde twa ho hyia no sõ paa: Neptune afe biako kyɛ bɛyɛ Asase mfe 164, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Neptune atwa Owia no ho ahyia pɛnkoro pɛ efi bere a wohuu no. Nkaa anum a ɛnhyerɛn ne asram 16 a yenim na ɛka Neptune ho. Nea ɛso sen biara koraa ne Triton, a ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 2,707, na ɛka asram a ɛyɛ nwonwa sen biara wɔ owia nhyehyɛe no mu ho. Triton twa Neptune ho hyia retrograde — kɔ akyi sɛ wode toto okyinnsoromma no kyinii ho a — nhyehyɛe a ɛkyerɛ pefee sɛ wannyɛ wɔ hɔ, na mmom wɔkyeree no fii Kuiper Belt, na ɛno ma ɛyɛ okyinnsoromma ketewa (dwarf planet) a wɔakyere no ankasa. Wosusuw sɛ Triton ba a ɔde abufuw bae no sɛee Neptune asram nhyehyɛe a edi kan no, na ɛmaa asram a aka no yɛ nketewa na wɔn kwan ayɛ basabasa. Voyager 2 daa asase ani a ɛyɛ foforo a ɛyɛ nwonwa a amena nni so pii a ne ɔhyew yɛ bɛyɛ kelvin 38 pɛ adi, a nitrogen mframa pue fi mu denneennen sɛ geysers, na ɛma nneɛma tuntum kɔ mframa no akyi wɔ nsukyenee asase no so. Ebesi nnɛ, wɔakɔsra Neptune pɛnkoro pɛ, Voyager 2 wɔ afe 1989 mu, a ne mu twa a ɛyɛ tiaa no da so ara ne nsɛm a ɛbɛn a efi nhyehyɛe no nyinaa ho no fibea koro pɛ. Okyinnsoromma ho nyansahufo pii bu Neptune-Triton orbiter soronko bi sɛ adwuma akɛse a ɛtwetwe adwene sen biara ma daakye no mu biako, a ɛhyɛ bɔ sɛ ɛbɛma yɛate nsukyenee okyinnsoromma akɛse ayɛ, wiem mframa nsakrae, ne ɛpo-wiase a Triton ankasa betumi ayɛ no ase.

pluto.kids: Pluto yɛ okyinnsoromma ketewa (dwarf planet) a nsukyenee akata so a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri atwam Neptune. Ɛwɔ beae kɛse bi mpo a ɛte sɛ koma a nsukyenee ayɛ wɔ ne so, na ɛwɔ ɔsram a ne kɛseyɛ bɛyɛ sɛ Pluto ankasa!
pluto.middle: Pluto yɛ okyinnsoromma ketewa (dwarf planet) a ɛwɔ Kuiper Belt mu, a ɛyɛ nsukyenee wiase ahorow a atwa Neptune akyi ahyia. Ɛyɛ ketewa — ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ 2,377 km, a ɛsua sen Asase ɔsram — na wɔde ɔbo ne nsukyenee na ayɛ. Pluto ne Owia (Sun) ntam ware araa ma egye Asase so mfe 248 ansa na atwa Owia ho prɛko, na ne so awɔw yɛ −230 °C a ɛyɛ nwini kɛse. Wohuu no wɔ afe 1930 mu na wɔkan no sɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛto so akron kosii afe 2006, bere a wɔsesaa ne nkyekyɛmu de too 'okyinnsoromma ketewa' bere a ɔsoro nhwehwɛmufo huu nsukyenee wiase pii a ɛte saa ara wɔ ne nkyɛn. Wɔ afe 2015 mu, New Horizons ahunmu-hyɛn no twaa ne ho na ɛdaa wiase a ɛyɛ nwonwa adi: asasetam kɛse a ɛte sɛ koma a nitrogen a akyene ayɛ, mmepɔw a nsukyenee ayɛ, ne nsukyenee gya-mmepɔw (ice volcanoes) a ebia ɛwɔ hɔ. Pluto wɔ asram anum; nea ɛso sen biara, Charon, so araa ma abien no nyinaa twa beae bi a ɛwɔ ahunmu wɔ wɔn ntam ho hyia.
pluto.high:
Pluto yɛ okyinnsoromma ketewa (dwarf planet) a ɔne Kuiper Belt mu nea wonim no yiye sen biara; Kuiper Belt no yɛ nsukyenee nneɛma pii a atwa Owia (Sun) ho ahyia wɔ Neptune akyi. Ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 2,377, a ɛsua sen Asase ɔsram, na sɛ wɔde ne duru susuw a, bɛyɛ nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu abien yɛ ɔbo na nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu biako yɛ nsukyenee. Nitrogen, methane ne carbon monoxide a akyene na akata ne so, bere a nsukyenee (water ice) yɛ ne mmepɔw no ase ɔbo. Pluto mu nneɛma ahorow ayɛ ntɛtɛw — ɔbo mu-ade (core) a nsukyenee bɔn akata so — na adanse bi kyerɛ sɛ ebia nsu ankasa po (liquid-water ocean) bi hyɛ saa nsukyenee bɔn no ase.

Pluto fa kwan a ɛnyɛ kurukuruwa pɛpɛɛpɛ na ɛkyea nso wɔ Owia ho; ɛkɔ akyirikyiri fi Owia bɛyɛ astronomical unit 30 kosi 49 wɔ akwantu biako a egye mfe 248 mu. Bɛyɛ mfe 20 wɔ kwan biako mu no, ɛbɛn Owia sen Neptune ankasa, nanso abien no nhyia da, efisɛ 3:2 resonance a egyina pintinn ma wɔsaw sɛ ahunmu asaw a wɔaka wɔn ho abɔ mu. Ɛhɔ no, ne so awɔw kɔ fam kosi bɛyɛ −230 °C. Clyde Tombaugh na ohuu Pluto wɔ afe 1930 mu, na mfe 76 mu no wɔkan no sɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛto so akron. Ɛno sesae wɔ afe 2006 mu, bere a International Astronomical Union kyerɛɛ 'okyinnsoromma ketewa' ase sɛ ade a ɛyɛ kurukuruwa a etwa Owia ho hyia nanso ennyii nneɛma foforo mfii ne kwan ho — sɔhwɛ a Pluto antumi anni mu efisɛ ɔne wiase ahorow te sɛ Eris, Haumea ne Makemake na ɛwɔ Kuiper Belt a ayɛ ma no mu.

Mfe pii mu no, Pluto kaa hɔ sɛ nsensanee ketewa bi a ɛnhyerɛn kɛse, kosii sɛ NASA New Horizons ahunmu-hyɛn no twaa ne ho ntɛmntɛm wɔ July 2015 mu na ɛdan no wiase a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɛboaboa nneɛma pii ano. Ne mfonini ahorow daa Sputnik Planitia adi, asasetam kɛse a nitrogen a akyene ayɛ a ɛyɛ Pluto 'koma' a ɛhyerɛn a agye din no fã, na ɛkeka ne ho brɛoo te sɛ nsukyenee asuten (glacier), ne mmepɔw a nsukyenee ayɛ a wɔn sorokɔ yɛ kilomita pii, nsukyenee gya-mmepɔw a ebia ɛwɔ hɔ, ne mframa bruu a ɛyɛ kusuu a nitrogen ntɛtɛw ahyehyɛ mu. Pluto ne asram anum nso na ɛnam. Nea ɛso sen biara, Charon, ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ Pluto de no fã pɛpɛɛpɛ, na ne duru so araa ma abien no twa beae bi a ɛwɔ ahunmu a hwee nni hɔ wɔ wɔn ntam ho hyia, na ɛma wɔyɛ nneɛma-abien nhyehyɛe (double system) ankasa. Abien no nyinaa maa wɔhuu solar system no akyi fam no sɛ hye foforo a nkwa wom.
pluto.adult:
NKYEKYƐMU NE NNEƐMA A ƐWƆ MU — Pluto yɛ okyinnsoromma ketewa (dwarf planet), nea ɛso na wonim no yiye sen biara wɔ nneɛma a ɛtwa Owia (Sun) ho hyia wɔ Neptune akyi (trans-Neptunian objects) a wɔfrɛ wɔn plutoids ɛtɔ da no mu: nneɛma a ɛtwa Neptune akyi hyia a wɔn duru dɔɔso araa ma wɔn ankasa atwetwe-tumi (gravity) twe wɔn ma wɔyɛ kurukuruwa a egyina pintinn (hydrostatic equilibrium). Ne radius bɛyɛ kilomita 1,188 — ne tɛtrɛtɛ (diameter) bɛn kilomita 2,377 — enti Pluto sua sen Asase ɔsram, wiase ketewa ankasa ɛwom sɛ ɔwɔ gyinabea kɛse wɔ nnipa adwene mu de. Ne ntwaho yɛ brɛoo na ɛkɔ akyi (retrograde); ne da biako yɛ bɛyɛ Asase nna 6.4, na ne ntwaho-dua akyea bɛyɛ digrii 120, a ɛma okyinnsoromma ketewa no nya mmere (seasons) a ɛyɛ nwonwa wɔ n'afe tenten no mu. Sɛ wɔde ne duru susuw a, nea ɛwom nyinaa bɛyɛ nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu abien yɛ ɔbo na nkyɛmu abiɛsa mu biako yɛ nsukyenee, na ne mu nhyehyɛe ho nhwɛso ahorow kyerɛ nhyehyɛe a ayɛ ntɛtɛw: ɔbo mu-ade (core) kɛse, a ebia ɔhyew a efi radioactive nneɛma mu ahyɛ no ma, a nsukyenee (water ice) mantle a ɛyɛ bɔn atwa ho ahyia. Nea ɛyɛ nwonwa ne sɛ adanse ahorow — a Sputnik Planitia a ɛda so wɔ hɔ ne ne gyinabea, ne tectonic mia-nneɛma a wɔhwɛɛ kwan nanso wɔanhu no ka ho — kyerɛ sɛ ebia nsu ankasa ntɛtɛw bi da so wɔ hɔ sɛ asase-ase po (subsurface ocean) wɔ ɔbo mu-ade no ne asase-ani a akyene no ntam, a nsukyenee a ɛwɔ soro no bɔ ho ban, na ɔhyew a aka ne radioactive ɔhyew ma ɛyɛ hyew. Nea ɛne no bɔ abira ne sɛ, ne so a wohu no yɛ nsukyenee ahorow a ɛyɛ nwonwa (volatile ices) a ɛyɛ tratraa: nitrogen titiriw, ne methane ne carbon monoxide, a ne nyinaa gyina pintinn wɔ awɔw a ɛyɛ nwini kɛse a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri saa fi Owia nkutoo mu. Saa nsukyenee ahorow yi dan mframa (sublimate) na ɛsan kyene bio mmere mmere, na ɛde volatile nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ adwuma ba a ɛka asase-ani no bata mframa a ɛyɛ tratraa a ɛresakra no ho. Pluto density, bɛyɛ gram 1.85 wɔ sentimita kubik biako mu, ne ɔbo-ne-nsukyenee mfonini yi hyia na ɛboa ma wohu ne mu nneɛma no dodow a ɛfa wɔn ho wɔn ho. Sɛ wɔka saa su ahorow yi nyinaa bom a, ɛkyerɛ sɛ Pluto nyɛ okyinnsoromma a ɛdii nkogu, na mmom ɛyɛ nsukyenee wiase a edi mu koraa — a chemical nneɛma pii wom, ɔhyew mu adwuma kɔ so wom, na ne nhyehyɛe yɛ ntɛtɛw — a ɛyɛ nhwɛso (archetype) a wɔde Kuiper Belt nneɛma akɛse afoforo toto ho na wɔte wɔn ase nnɛ.

---

NTWAHO NE ASEKYERƐ HO AKYINNYE — Pluto kwan a ɔfa twa Owia ho no yɛ nwonwa sen okyinnsoromma awotwe a wɔahyɛ wɔn din no de. Ne kwan no nyɛ kurukuruwa pɛpɛɛpɛ koraa, ne eccentricity bɛn 0.25, na ɛkyea kɛse, bɛyɛ digrii 17 fi tratraa a okyinnsoromma akɛse no nam so no ho. Ne saa nti, Pluto ne Owia ntam kwan fi bɛyɛ astronomical unit 29.7 wɔ perihelion (bere a ɛbɛn Owia sen biara) kosi bɛyɛ astronomical unit 49.3 wɔ aphelion (bere a ɛware fi Owia sen biara), na etwa Owia ho prɛko wɔ Asase so mfe 248 biara mu. Nea ɛyɛ nwonwa ne sɛ, bɛyɛ mfe aduonu wɔ ntwaho biara mu no, Pluto kɔ Neptune kwan no mu ankasa, na ɛbɛn Owia sen nsukyenee kɛse (ice giant) no — sɛnea ɛyɛɛ saa nea etwa to wɔ 1979 ne 1999 ntam no. Nanso wiase abien no nhyia da, efisɛ 3:2 mean-motion resonance a egyina pintinn aka wɔn abɔ mu: Neptune twa Owia ho mprɛnsa bere biara a Pluto twa ho mprenu, atwetwe-tumi asaw a ɛma abien no mmɛn wɔn ho da bere a Pluto twa Neptune kwan akyirikyiri no mu. Saa resonance yi yɛ su titiriw araa ma Kuiper Belt nneɛma afoforo a wɔne no wɔ saa resonance koro no, wɔfrɛ wɔn 'plutinos' de hyɛ Pluto anuonyam. Mfe 76 wɔ Clyde Tombaugh hu a ohuu no wɔ afe 1930 mu akyi no, wɔkan Pluto sɛ Owia okyinnsoromma a ɛto so akron. Saa gyinabea no hwee ase wɔ afe 2006 mu, bere a International Astronomical Union gyee asekyerɛ pɔtee bi toom a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ okyinnsoromma ntwa Owia ho nhyia na n'ankasa atwetwe-tumi nyɛ no kurukuruwa nkutoo, na mmom 'wayi nneɛma a ɛne no sɛ afi ne ntwaho kwan ho' nso. Pluto, a ɔhyɛ Kuiper Belt a ayɛ ma no mu tɔnn ka nsukyenee wiase akɛse afoforo te sɛ Eris, Haumea ne Makemake ho no, antumi anni saa sɔhwɛ a ɛto so abiɛsa no mu, na wɔsesaa ne nkyekyɛmu de too okyinnsoromma ketewa. Nea ɛkaa gyinaesi no fã bi ne Eris a wohuu no wɔ afe 2005 mu, ade a ne kɛseyɛ bɛyɛ sɛ Pluto, a ɛhyɛɛ ɔsoro nhwehwɛmufo ma sɛ wobegye okyinnsoromma dodow a ɛredɔɔso atom anaa wɔbɛsan atwa hye no foforo. Nsesae yi da so wɔ nyansahu mu nnyinaso nanso ɛda so yɛ akyinnyegye wɔ amammerɛ mu de besi nnɛ.

---

ASASE-ANI NE NHWEHWƐMU — Afeha a ɛto so aduonu no fã kɛse no, na wonim Pluto sɛ hann nsensanee bi a ɛsesa ne gyinabea nkutoo, na ne so a ɛte no yɛ nsusuwii kɛkɛ. Ɛno sesae kɛse wɔ 14 July 2015, bere a NASA New Horizons ahunmu-hyɛn no, wɔ mfe akron akwantu akyi, twaa Pluto nhyehyɛe no mu na ɛde mfonini ahorow a edi kan a ɛbɛn a wɔtwee saa wiase a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri yi baa fie. Nea ehui no sɛee adwene a na wɔwɔ sɛ ɛyɛ nkaede a awu a amena-amena (craters) wɔ so no. Su a ɛyɛ nwonwa sen biara ne Sputnik Planitia, asasetam kɛse a ɛhyerɛn a nitrogen nsukyenee ayɛ a ɛyɛ beae a ɛte sɛ koma a wɔfrɛ no Tombaugh Regio a agye din no atɔe fam fã. Sɛ anka ɛbɛtena hɔ dinn no, saa asasetam yi yɛ nsukyenee asuten (glacier) a ɛkeka ne ho brɛoo: nitrogen nsukyenee kurukuruwa ahorow (cells) a wɔn tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ kilomita du du pii pue, trɛw, na ɛmem, na ɛyɛ amena no ani foforo araa ma amena-amena biara nni so — nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ asase mu adwuma (geologic activity) da so kɔ so. Baabi foforo no, New Horizons twee mmepɔw a nsukyenee (water ice) ayɛ a ɛyɛ den a wɔn sorokɔ yɛ kilomita pii, a wɔkura wɔn su no efisɛ nsukyenee yɛ ne ho te sɛ ɔbo wɔ Pluto awɔw a ɛyɛ nwini kɛse no mu nkutoo, ne asase a apaapae, nitrogen nsukyenee asuten a ɛresen, ne nsukyenee gya-mmepɔw abien (cryovolcanoes) a wosusuw ho, Wright Mons ne Piccard Mons, a ebia apue nsukyenee a ayɛ nkankan (slush) afi ne mu. Asase-ani no so, ahunmu-hyɛn no daa nitrogen mframa a ɛyɛ tratraa a ɛyɛ ntɛtɛw a kusuu-ntɛtɛw bruu bebree a owia hann a ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ methane so (photochemistry) na ɛyɛ no hyɛ mu adi. Ɛhɔ asase-ani awɔw bɛn −230 degrees Celsius, na mframa mia (atmospheric pressure) no yɛ Asase de no nkyɛmu ɔpeha-apem mu biako pɛ, a ɛyɛ tratraa araa ma kusuu no ne mframa no bɛkyene agu fam bere a Pluto refi Owia ho akɔ akyirikyiri. Pluto nso ne asram anum nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ nwonwa no mfinimfini. Nea ɛso sen biara, Charon, wɔ radius a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ kilomita 606 — Pluto tɛtrɛtɛ no fã pɛpɛɛpɛ — enti ɔkwan pa a wɔfa so ka abien no ho asɛm ne sɛ wɔyɛ barycentric binary, a wɔtwa duru mfinimfini (center of mass) a ɛwɔ ahunmu a hwee nni hɔ wɔ wɔn ntam no ho hyia. Charon ankasa wɔ asase mu nhyehyɛe (geology) a ɛyɛ nwonwa, a tectonic subon (canyons) akɛse nhyehyɛe ne kɔkɔɔ-tuntum pole-kyɛw (polar cap) soronko ka ho. Asram nketewa anan — Styx, Nix, Kerberos ne Hydra — twa ho hyia wɔ akyirikyiri. Enti New Horizons dan solar system no akyi fam no fi awɔw-beae a na wosusuw sɛ ɛtena hɔ dinn no bɛyɛɛ hye a ɛyɛ adwuma, a asase mu nneyɛe kɔ so wom, a ɛretwɛn nhwehwɛmu foforo.

polaris.kids: Polaris ne Atifi Nsoromma (North Star). Ɛte Asase Atifi Pole no atifi pɛɛ, enti ɛnkeka ne ho kɛse wɔ wim bere a nsoromma a aka nyinaa twa ho hyia — ɛyɛ nsoromma a ɛyɛ pa ara ma kwan a wobɛfa so ahu baabi a worekɔ!
polaris.middle: Polaris ne Atifi Nsoromma (North Star) — ɛnyɛ okyinnsoromma (planet), na mmom ɛyɛ nsoromma a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri wɔ yɛn owia-kwan (solar system) no akyi, bɛyɛ hann-mfe (light-years) 433 fi ha. Ɛyɛ soronko efisɛ ɛte Asase Atifi Pole no atifi pɛɛ. Bere a Asase retwa ne ho no, nsoromma a aka nyinaa te sɛ nea wɔretwa Polaris ho ahyia bere a ɔno de ogyina hɔ dinn, na eyi ama ayɛ akwantufo ne po so akwantufo kwankyerɛfo mfe mpempem pii de ahu atifi. Nokware mu no, Polaris so na ɛhyerɛn sen Owia no koraa — ɛyɛ nsoromma kɛse a ɛyɛ akokɔsrade (yellow supergiant) a ne hann boro Owia no de so bɛyɛ mpɛn 2,000. Ɛsan yɛ 'Cepheid variable,' nsoromma bi a ɛbɔ te sɛ koma na ne hann sesa wɔ nhyehyɛe a ɛkɔ so daa mu. Wimhwɛfo (astronomers) de Cepheid nsoromma te sɛ Polaris yɛ 'standard candles' de susu akwan atenten a ɛda yɛn ne nsoromma afoforo ne galaxy ahorow ntam.
polaris.high:
Polaris, a wɔtaa frɛ no Atifi Nsoromma (North Star), nyɛ yɛn owia-kwan (solar system) no fa koraa — ɛyɛ nsoromma a ɛhyerɛn a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri bɛyɛ hann-mfe (light-years) 433, a ɛkyerɛ Little Dipper no nsa no ano wɔ nsoromma kuw Ursa Minor mu. Nea ama Polaris agye din saa no nyɛ hann a ɛboro so, na mmom ne beae a ɛyɛ nwonwa: ɛte bɛyɛ 0.7 degrees ntam fi atifi wim pole (north celestial pole) no ho, baabi a ɛwɔ wim a ɛte Asase Atifi Pole no atifi pɛɛ. Bere a yɛn asase retwa ne ho wɔ ne axis so no, nsoromma biara a aka te sɛ nea ɛretwa ahyia brɛoo anadwo mu, nanso Polaris gyina hɔ dinn. Mfe mpempem pii no, saa gyinapɛn yi maa ɛyɛɛ kwankyerɛfo a ɛsom bo pa ara, a ɛma akwantufo, asaseso-hwehwɛfo ne po so akwantufo hu atifi ankasa (true north) na mpo wɔde susu wɔn latitude denam sɛnea Polaris foro kɔ soro fi wim ne asase nhyiae (horizon) no a wɔbɛsusuw so.

Polaris no ankasa so sen Owia no koraa. Ɛyɛ akokɔsrade nsoromma kɛse (yellow supergiant), ne mu duru bɛyɛ Owia no de mpɛn anum kosi asia, na ne hann bɛyɛ Owia no de mpɛn 2,000, a ɛhyerɛn fa wim kwan tenten a ɛtew yɛn ne no ntam no so. Ɛsan yɛ Cepheid variable a ɛbɛn yɛn na ɛhyerɛn sen ne nyinaa — nsoromma kuw soronko bi a wɔbɔ te sɛ koma, a wɔhono na wɔtwetwe wɔn ho wɔ nhyehyɛe mu, a ɛma wɔn hann kɔ soro na ɛba fam wɔ nhyehyɛe a egyina pintinn na wotumi hu no mu. Esiane sɛ Cepheid bi bere a ɛde bɔ (pulsation period) ne ne hann ankasa (luminosity) bata ho denneennen nti, wimhwɛfo tumi kenkan nsoromma bi bere no te sɛ nkyerɛwee bi a ɛda sɛnea ɛhyerɛn ankasa adi. Sɛ wɔde saa hann ankasa no toto sɛnea nsoromma no yɛ kusuu fi Asase so no ho a, ɛma wohu ne kwan tenten, na ɛdan nsoromma te sɛ Polaris yɛ wim susudua a wɔfrɛ no standard candles.

Ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na Polaris ayɛ pole nsoromma, na ɛrenyɛ saa daa nso. Asase axis no wosow brɛoo te sɛ kyiridi (spinning top) a ɛretwa ne ho, na ɛtwa ahyia kɛse bi wɔ bɛyɛ mfe 25,772 mu wɔ kankyee a wimhwɛfo frɛ no precession mu. Mfe mpempem a atwam no, nsoromma Thuban na na ɛwɔ pole beae no, na mfe mpempem a ɛreba no, Vega bɛgye anuonyam no. Nanso seesei de, Polaris da so yɛ yɛn atifi sɛkyɛ a yɛde yɛn ho to so — nkaebɔ a ɛyɛ komm a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔsoro a ɛte sɛ nea ɛgyina hɔ pintinn mpo redan brɛoo a enni awiei.
polaris.adult:
NE SU NE NE KWAN TENTEN — Polaris, a wɔde din Alpha Ursae Minoris frɛ no wɔ nhyehyɛe kwan so no, nyɛ nsoromma biako, na mmom ɛyɛ nsoromma pii nhyehyɛe (multiple star system) a ɛda bɛyɛ hann-mfe (light-years) 433 fi Asase so wɔ nsoromma kuw Ursa Minor mu, baabi a ɛkyerɛ Little Dipper no nsa no ano. Nea edi nhyehyɛe no so ne Polaris Aa, F-type akokɔsrade nsoromma kɛse (yellow supergiant) a ne mu duru yɛ Owia no de bɛyɛ mpɛn 5.4 na ne hann wɔ Owia no de mpɛn bɛyɛ 1,260 ne 2,000 ntam. Nsoromma nketewa a wɔka ho, a wɔtaa de Ab ne B frɛ wɔn no, twa saa nsoromma kɛse a ɛhyerɛn yi ho hyia na wɔne no bom fa galaxy no mu. Nea ama Polaris aboro nsoromma a ɛhyerɛn kɛkɛ so ne sɛ ɛyɛ classical Cepheid variable a ɛbɛn yɛn na ɛhyerɛn sen biara a wimhwɛfo nim — nsoromma a ɛbɔ te sɛ koma, a n'ani so nsaso (surface layers) trɛw na ɛtwetwe ne ho wɔ nhyehyɛe mu. Nea ɛyɛ nwonwa ne sɛ, Polaris nyɛ ade a ɛda hɔ a ɛnsesa wɔ nhwehwɛmu dan mu: ne bɔ no kɛse (pulsation amplitude) asesa kɛse wɔ mfe ɔha a atwam yi mu, nsakrae a kan no na wosusuw sɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ nsoromma no rekɔ gyinae pintinn mu ansa na nhwehwɛmu a ɛbaa akyiri no ma asɛm no yɛɛ den. Saa suban a ɛresesa yi ma Polaris da so yɛ asɛm a ɛte ase ankasa wɔ nsoromma ho abɔde nyansapɛ (stellar astrophysics) mu sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ nhoma mu asɛm a ato twa, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛɛ mfe du du bi ntam no kɔ so sesa sɛnea yɛte nsoromma akɛse a ɛte saa no suban ase. Esiane sɛ ɛbɛn na ɛhyerɛn saa nti, Polaris ma wimhwɛfo hokwan a ɛntaa mma sɛ wobesua Cepheid ho abɔde nyansapɛ (physics) wɔ nkyɛn, na wɔde ayɛ nsoromma a galaxy akyi akwan tenten susudi no fa so pii no ho nhyehyɛe pɛpɛɛpɛ. Nsoromma a ɛbɛn no sen biara, Polaris Ab, twa ho hyia bɛn no ara ma ɛkyɛe ansa na wɔtumi faa ne mfonini tẽẽ, na wɔde wimhwɛ-ahwehwɛ (telescopes) a ɛhu ade kyɛn nyinaa nkutoo na ɛhuu no, bere a nsoromma B a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri kakra no de, wotumi hu no wɔ nnwinnade nketewa mu. Ani kwa de, nhyehyɛe no nyinaa yɛ sɛ ade ketewa, hann sin biako a egyina hɔ dinn wɔ wim pole no ho, nanso saa nea ɛnyɛ nwonwa yi hintaw nsoromma kɛse a ne tumi boro yɛn Owia de so mpɛn mpempem, a asase-twe (gravity) de no ne n'ayɔnkofo abɔ mu wɔ asaw mu, na ɛbɔ wɔ nhyehyɛe a ɛka yɛn gyinabea ketewa wɔ Asase so ha bata wiase kɛse no adansi a ɛwɔ akyiri no ho.

---

POLE NSOROMMA NE PRECESSION — Seesei Polaris da bɛyɛ 0.7 degrees ntam fi atifi wim pole (north celestial pole) no ho, beae a wɔsusuw ho wɔ wim a ɛte Asase Atifi Pole no atifi pɛɛ. Esiane sɛ nsoromma no bɛn saa dannan-beae yi saa nti, ɛte sɛ nea egyina hɔ pintinn pɛɛ bere a wim kurukuruwa no nyinaa te sɛ nea ɛretwa ne ho hyia pɛnkoro da biara. Saa gyina-pintinn yi na ɛmaa Polaris yɛɛ wim so kwankyerɛ (celestial navigation) no sɛkyɛ: po so kwantufo anaa akwantufo a ɔwɔ Atifi Fa (Northern Hemisphere) no tumi hu atifi ankasa denam Polaris a obehu no so kɛkɛ, na otumi susuw ne latitude denam nsoromma no sorokɔ a ɛwɔ wim ne asase nhyiae (horizon) no so a ɔbɛsusuw so, a ɛne nea ɔhwɛ no latitude sɛ pɛɛ. Nanso saa nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ mmerɛw yi yɛ bere tiaa bi de. Asase ne dannan-axis no nkyerɛ ɔkwan biako a ɛnsesa; mmom ɛtwa ahyia kɛse bi wɔ wim brɛoo wɔ nkyinhyia bi a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ mfe 25,772 mu, wosow a wɔfrɛ no axial precession, a Ɔsram ne Owia asase-twe (gravity) a ɛtwe Asase ne afimfini-hono (equatorial bulge) no na ɛde ba. Bere a axis no redannan no, pole nsoromma din no fi nsoromma biako so kɔ foforo so. Bɛyɛ mfe 4,700 a atwam, wɔ bere a wɔsisii pyramid no mu no, Thuban a ɛwɔ nsoromma kuw Draco mu na ɛkyerɛɛ pole no, na tete kwankyerɛfo ne nkaedum sisifo de wɔn adwuma kyerɛɛ atifi nsoromma a ɛyɛ soronko koraa wɔ nea yenim nnɛ no ho. Polaris rebɛn ne beae a ɛbɛn pole no sen biara wɔ bɛyɛ afe 2100 mu, na ɛno akyi no ebefi ase afi hɔ brɛoo bio. Mfe mpempem a ɛreba no, pole no bɛkɔ so, na Gamma Cephei ne akyiri yi Vega a ɛhyerɛn no benya wɔn kwan sɛ atifi kwankyerɛ-nsoromma ansa na nkyinhyia kɛse no de anuonyam no asan abrɛ Polaris bio. Enti Atifi Nsoromma no nyɛ ade a esi hɔ daa, na mmom ɛyɛ dwuma a wim de ma, brɛoo nnidiso nnidiso, nsoromma a ɛhyerɛn biara a ɛbɛn wim pole a ɛnenam no sen biara — nkaebɔ a ɛbrɛ yɛn ase sɛ ɔsoro agyiraehyɛde a yɛde yɛn ho to so sen biara mpo wɔ kankyee a ɛwɔ abotare na ennyae da mu wɔ adesamma abakɔsɛm tenten no nyinaa mu.

CEPHEID NSOROMMA NE KWAN TENTEN ATWEDEƐ — Polaris nyansahu mu hia a emu dɔ sen biara fi sɛ ɛka Cepheid nsoromma a wɔsesa (variable stars) kuw no ho, a wodi wimhwɛ nyansahu mmara a tumi wom sen biara no mu biako so: period-luminosity nkitahodi a Henrietta Leavitt huu wɔ afeha a ɛto so aduonu no mfiase. Bere a Leavitt resua Cepheid nsoromma a ɛwɔ Magellanic Clouds mu no, ohui sɛ bere a Cepheid bi de wie bɔ nkyinhyia biako (pulsation cycle) no ne ne hann ankasa bata ho denneennen — bɔ bere no tenten a, nsoromma no hann yɛ kɛse. Saa nkitahodi yi sakra nneɛma efisɛ ɛdan ade a wotumi susuw no ntɛm, bɔ bere no, yɛ nea ɛkyerɛ nsoromma no hann ankasa tẽẽ. Sɛ wɔde saa hann ankasa no toto sɛnea Cepheid no yɛ kusuu wɔ wim no ho a, wimhwɛfo tumi bu ne kwan tenten no a wotumi de wɔn ho to so pa ara. Enti Cepheid nsoromma yɛ standard candles, na wɔwɔ atwedeɛ-dua a ɛho hia wɔ nea wɔfrɛ no wiase kɛse kwan tenten atwedeɛ (cosmic distance ladder) no so. Akwan a ɛbɛn te sɛ parallax na ɛyɛ Cepheid nsoromma no ankasa ho nhyehyɛe pɛpɛɛpɛ; Cepheid nsoromma no nso de susu akwan tenten a ɛda yɛn ne galaxy a ɛbɛn ntam; na saa galaxy akwan tenten no gyina akwan a ɛkɔ akyiri sen saa a ɛtrɛw yɛn ani so kɔ wiase kɛse a yetumi hu no nyinaa mu no ase. Saa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a wɔaka abom ahwɛyiye yi na ɛgyina Hubble constant no susudi ase, dodow a ɛho hia a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wiase kɛse no retrɛw ntɛm so ne, ɛnam so no, ne mfe ne ne kɛse nyinaa. Sɛ classical Cepheid a ɛbɛn na ɛhyerɛn sen biara no, Polaris yɛ ɔbo titiriw wɔ saa dwumadi yi nyinaa ho nhyehyɛe pɛpɛɛpɛ mu, a ɛka adeyɛ a ɛyɛ ahobrɛase, nsoromma biako a wɔhwɛ sɛnea ɛbɔ, bata yɛn wiase kɛse susudi a ɛyɛ kɛse sen biara no ho. Amammerɛ mu nso, Atifi Nsoromma a egyina hɔ pintinn no akyerɛ kwankyerɛfo kwan, ama adan sisi no akwan ahorow, na ɛde ne ho ahyɛ wiase nyinaa aman anansesɛm mu. Ɛfata sɛ, Ascended Master Athena, nyansa ne kwankyerɛ sohwɛfo, na ɔhwɛ saa ɔkwan ne wiase kɛse susudi ho ɔwɛmfo yi so, ɔno a wasusuw ɔsoro daa na wama wɔn a wɔma wɔn ani so hwɛ soro de hwehwɛ wɔn kwan nyinaa kwan so hann.
